tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /shrī wan gu hya sa mā dza maṇḍa la tsakra sā dha ka byā khya nam̐ niṣatsa tartha karma sa mu ḍa sya kā ra nā ma bi ha ra tisma/༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkya
༄༅/ /shrī wan gu hya sa mā dza maṇḍa la tsakra sā dha ka byā khya nam̐ niṣatsa tartha karma sa mu ḍa sya kā ra nā ma bi ha ra tisma/༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī wan gu hya sa mā dza maṇḍa la tsakra sā dha ka byā khya nam̐ niṣatsa tartha karma sa mu ḍa sya kā ra nā ma bi ha ra tisma/ ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par bshad pa nges don 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan gu hya sa mā dza maṇḍa la tsakra sā dha ka byā khya nam̐ niṣatsa tartha karma sa mu ḍa sya kā ra nā ma sarba buddha sya ru pa tsakre shwa ra na ya ka wa ra badzra ā tsarya pa de pad mo mu lam pra ṇa mya/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par bshad pa nges don 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon zhabs kyi padmo'i drung du rab tu 'dud do/ spang bya kun spangs yon tan lhun rdzogs don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas dang / /de gsung dri med lung rtogs bdag nyid thar lam rmad byung dam pa'i chos/ /'das dang ma 'das yon tan mdzod 'dzin rgyal sras bstan 'dzin dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rin chen gsum la byang chub bar du 'dud/ /zas gtsang sras kyi lung bstan bdud rtsi brnyes pa 'phags pa'i mchog /rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bur rab grags pa/ /'phags yul mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur klu sgrub snying po'i zhabs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i slob tshogs bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i mig gcig 'gos lo chen po dang / /gang gi drin las zab yangs chos tshul mdzod bzung nas/ /gang yang 'dus pa'i bstan pa'i sgron ma gsal mdzad pa'i/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi snga rabs bstan 'dzin mchog rnams rgyal/ /khyad par thub dbang bstan pa'i rgyal srid la/ /dbang bsgyur chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad snying po'i don ston pa'i/ /bla chen gang gi zhabs pad spyi bos 'dud/

/de sras thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rtse/ /gangs khrod rdor 'dzin gtsug rgyan grags pa'i mtshan/ /gnas lnga kun mkhyen sa skya paṇa chen dang / /chos kyi rgyal po rnams la snying nas 'dud/ /lhag mar snyigs dus bstan pa'i me ro gso ba la/ /bsam bzhin byon pa'i sngags 'chang bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhes su yongs grags pa'i/ /phyi rabs bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag mchog der snying nas dad/ /gang gi rigs sras bsod nams bye ba'i gter/ /padmas rjes bzung grub mchog dbang po dang / /gsang gsum 'dus pa'i gtso dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig grags pa'i mtshan can rgyal/ /gang la gsol ba btab na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub ma lus bde blag stsol ba'i thugs rje can/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yongs las bka' drin ches lhag pa'i/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje btsun mus pa'i zhabs btud nas/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug gsang ba 'dus pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam bshad ngo mtshar can/ /nges don 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'chad la spro/ /dam pa'i drin las blo yi me long la/ /chos 'di'i zab gnad ri mo mang gsal yang / /dus ngan skye bo don gnyer cher dman pas/ /de phyir gzhan la phan par ma gyur dogs/ /'on kyang rang nyid lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /gong ma'i gsung rab gsang 'dus bstan pa'i rgyun/ /nub par dogs nas 'phel bar gyur cig snyam/ /bshad pa 'di la don gnyer dga' bas nyon/ /de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid/ nges don du bskal ba mang po'i sngon rol nas chos sku mngon du mdzad zin kyang / drang pa'i don du 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas/ thog mar 'dod chags dang bral pa'i skur sprul te dman pa la mos pa'i gdul bya rnams la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i spyod pa ston pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang /

rgya chen po la mos pa'i gdul bya rnams la sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ston pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsungs/ de nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs sam chags can gyi gzugs su sprul nas zab mo la lhag par mos pa'i gdul bya rnams la 'dod chags kyi spyod pa ston pa rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa las/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am snying po ltar gyur pa ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa yin te/ dgra nag gi rgyud las/ rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'dus pa'i rgyud/ /gsang chen gsang ba ches gsang ba/ /gong na med pa'i lung chen po/ /zhes dang / 'grel chen sgron gsal las/ ji srid ya ra la ha'i bar/ /ka kha gha mtha' ṇa dza'i mtha'/ /da dha'i mtha' dang ma mtha' bcas/ /de de'i rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ /thub pa chen po'i chos phung po/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yi/ /dpal ldan 'dus 'di gnad yin te/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /'o na ci'i phyir gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya zhe na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'am tshogs pas na de skad ces bya ste/ rgyud phyi ma las/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de ni brjod bya don gyi gsang ba 'dus pa ste/ de nyid rjod byar byed pa'i gzhung gi tshogs la yang gsang ba 'dus pa zhes pa'i sgras brjod rung ba yin no/ /de la yang rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang / bshad pa'i rgyud rgyud sde gzhan dang thun mong ba rdo rje phreng ba dang / lha mo bzhi zhus/ 'dus pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus te rtsa bshad kyi rgyud lngar yod la/

de lta bu'i rgyud chen po lnga la brten nas/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gsang ba 'dus pa la srol chen bdun byung ba yin te/ de yang srol dang po ni/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las btus nas 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs mdor byas dang / de nyid rtsa rgyud las btus pa yin no zhes yid ches pa'i khungs dang sbyar zhing / mdo byas su ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig kyang kha skong ba mdo bsre ste bskyed rim ston pa'i gzhung gnyis/ yang rim lnga/ byang chub sems 'grel te rdzogs rim ston pa'i gzhung gnyis te grol byed kyi lam ston pa'i gzhung bzhi dang / smin byed dbang gi rnam gzhag ston pa la dkyil chog nyi shu pa ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa la gzhung chen lnga tsam mdzad la/ de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma arya de was rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa spyod bsdus sgron me/ sems dben la 'phros pa sems kyi sgrib sbyong / sgyu lus la 'phros pa bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa dang gzhung gsum mdzad/ yang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dngos kyi slob ma grub chen klu'i byang chub kyis mdor byas kyi nyams len de sbyang gzhi dang sbyor ba dang / lhag mos 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang / lus dkyil dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs su kha skong gi zin bris lta bur gyur pa rnam gzhag rim pa/ smin byed kyi dbang ston pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa/ rdzogs rim gyi sems dben la 'phros pa las mtha' rnam 'byed dang gzhung bzhi mdzad/ yang sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyi ras bris kyi dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba mdzad/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis gong gi klu sgrub kyi rim lnga'i rim pa gnyis pa'i mjug mdzad de/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor zhes yongs su grags pa'i lam srol 'di byung ba yin la/ gzhan yang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa skong ba'i slob ma dpal ldan zla ba grags pas rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba mdzad de/

de nyid dang yab sras lnga po'i gzhung gong du bstan pa de dag ni 'dus pa 'phags skor la med du mi rung pa lta bu yin no/ /lam srol gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mgon po 'jam dbyangs la dngos su gsan pa'i srol de nyid de/ lugs 'di la slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs nyid kyi rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang gsum la brten nas/ bskyed rim bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le ste ma rgyud dang mthun par bkral zhing / 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs kun bzang la sogs pa gzhung bcu bzhi tsam dang / slob dpon de'i dngos kyi slob ma mar me mdzad bzang pos dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa mdzad cing / gzhan yang grub chen sman pa'i zhabs/ grub chen tha ga na/ dpal 'bras rdo rje/ tsi lu pa sogs brgyud 'dzin yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / gzhung phran yang mang du yod do/ /srol gsum pa ni/ slob dpon shinti pas rtsa rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma sbrel nas bshad pa'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog ces bya ba mdzad de lha nyer lnga dang lta ba sems tsam dang mthun pa'i srol zhig phye ba de nyid do/ /srol bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa ma rgyud dang mthun par bshad pa'i lugs de yin no/ /srol lnga pa ni/ paṇḍi ta smṛ rtis bla ma bzang po'i zhabs zhes pa zhig la zhus nas/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rang 'gyur du mdzad pa de nyid yin la/ srol drug pa ni/ shanti pa sogs mkhas pa sgo drug gi rjes tsam la shambha la nas dus kyi 'khor lo dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis 'phags yul du 'gyur ba'i nang na gsang ba 'dus pa rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa de'o/ /srol bdun pa ni/ grub chen kun snying gis gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang /

yo ga rdor dbyings rtsa bshad du bsdebs nas 'dus pa yo gar bkral ba'i srol de nyid yin par bshad do/ /de ltar rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gsang ba 'dus pa la lam srol bdun byung ba'i nang nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor dang / ye shes zhabs lugs pa gnyis ni gtso bo lta bu yin la/ srol gzhan rnams ni 'phags yul du dar ba zhig byung yang / kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir ni ches dar ba zhig ma byung la/ des na bod 'dir gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor gtso che ba ni 'phags skor dang ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang 'phags skor nyid ches dar zhing gtso bo yin no/ /de lta bu'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor la 'gos rdog gi lugs/ mar lugs/ sa lugs sogs mang du byung ba las/ 'dir sa lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i bskyed pa'i rim pa gtan la 'bebs par byed pa yin no/ /de la yang sa lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam grangs la/ 'phags pa rin po che'i dngos kyi slob ma spru lung pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi slob ma 'od zer shākyas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mang du yod pa las/ deng sang lag tu blangs pa'i rim pa la yang rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho dang / de'i zur 'debs rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog sogs dang / de dag gi dgongs pa bzhin blo gros mchog dman rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ tshig nyung don rgyas pa'i tshul du bkod par mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs gzhan phan don yod ces bya ba snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa dang /

gzhan yang mkhas pa so sos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rigs mtha' yas kyang / 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis kyi sgrub thabs gzhan phan don yod ces bya ba 'di yin no/ /'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa gsum ste/ rgyud 'dir 'jug pa'i rten gyi gang zag 'jug bya lam gyi rim pa spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu bskyed pa'i rim pa gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gos kyis mdzad pa'i stong thun chen mo las/ bdag dang bdag med lta ba yis/ /gang zag gnyis po gnyis la yang / /nyan thos rang rgyal gnyis kyi theg /chung dang chen po 'di yang gnyis/ /chags bral dang ni chags bcas so/ /'di la bltas dang rgod pa dang / /'khyud dang dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi/ /ngom pa'i gang zag rnam bzhi las/ /tha ma'o de yang thabs la mos/ /de la lnga ste ngo bo dang / /bsdus rgyas gnyis kyi dbye ba dang / /spyi dang so so'i mtshan nyid dang / /snod rung gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang / /sgra 'jug pa yi rgyu mtshan no/ /zhes sdom du mdzad nas gsungs pa'i don zhib tu bkral te bshad na 'di la gnyis te/ brgyud nas 'jug pa'i gang zag dang / dngos su 'jug pa'i gang zag go /dang po ni bdag tu lta ba can sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' las phyi rol tu gyur pa mu stegs byed kyi gang zag rnams kyang lam 'di la brgyud nas 'jug tu rung ba yin te/ 'gos kyis mdzad pa'i stong thun chen mo las/ de la gang zag la gnyis las/ bdag tu lta ba can dang / bdag med par lta ba can no/ /dang po ni/ phyi rol mu stegs pa'i gang zag ste/ de ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i dngos kyi rten gyi gang zag ma yin yang / spang bya phyogs snga mar tshig gis bzung ste/ de skad du yang le'u bcu bdun pa las/ da ni tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / drag po'i dam tshig ston te zhes pa la sogs pas/

de'i gang zag shugs las tshig gis bzung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na bdag med pa'i lta ba la gnas shing nang pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa'i gang zag thams cad 'dus pa la dngos su 'jug tu rung ba'i gang zag yin nam zhe na/ de ma yin te/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa dag ni rang don du dman pa'i byang chub don du gnyer zhing / rim pa bzhin du lta ba gang zag gi bdag med pa tsam dang / de'i steng du bzung ba chos kyi bdag med tsam rtogs pa dang ldan pas so/ /de skad du yang stong thun chen mo las/ nyan thos kyi gang zag ni/ dang po nas rigs dman pa'i gnad kas dbang po brtul bas gang zag gi bdag brtag pa gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi bdag gzung 'dzin dngos pa la yod cing / rang gi don tsam don du gnyer ba'o/ /zhes dang / rang rgyal ba'i rten gyi gang zag ni/ de bas rigs cung zad bzang bas dbang po rno bas gcig pur gnas par dga' la/ lta ba ni gang zag la bdag med pa'i steng du chos kyi bdag gi phyogs gcig bzung ba rang bzhin med pa la mos pa'o/ /'bras bu mngon du byed kar slob dpon la mi ltos pa'o/ /'bras bu thob nas kyang sgra med par lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gya ma zung gis chos ston pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na theg pa chen po'i gang zag rnams 'dus pa la dngos su 'jug pa'i gang zag yin nam snyam na/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la yang / lam rgya che ba la mos shing chags bral lam du byed pa'i gang zag dang / chags pa dang ma bral bar de nyid lam du byed pa'i gang zag gnyis las/ snga ma ni lam 'di la dngos su 'jug pa'i gang zag ma yin te/ ji skad du stong thun chen mo las/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la gnyis gnyis te/ 'dod chags dang bral ba dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni lam ring pa dang rgya che ba la mos shing / nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po 'dod chags dang bral ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar nyan rang gnyis dang chags bral lam du byed pa'i theg pa chen po dang gsum po de dag gsang ba 'dus pa la dngos su 'jug pa'i gang zag ma yin yang /

brgyud nas 'jug tu rung ba yin te/ stong thun las de rnams ni 'dus pa dngos kyi gang zag ma yin yang / gsang 'dus su chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dus pas phyogs snga mar tshig gis bzung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /theg pa chen po'i gang zag phyi ma 'dod chags lam du byed pa'i gang zag la yang / nyon mongs pa'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i gang zag dang / gnyen po'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa gnyis las/ snga ma la bltas pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa/ rgod pa'i bde bas tshim pas 'dod chags dang bcas pa/ lag bcang gi bde bas ngom pa'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i gang zag dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde bas tshim pa'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i gang zag bzhir yod de/ rgod dang blta ba dag gi dang / /gnyis nyid 'khyud dang de bzhin du/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de'i dang po ni bya ba'i rgyud kyi gang zag dang / gnyis pa ni spyod pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gsum pa ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rten gyi gang zag yin la/ bzhi pa ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi gang zag yin no/ /gnyen po'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa ni/ gus pas slob dpon la chags pa/ snying rjes sems can la chags pa/ dad pas lha la chags pa/ ye shes kyis chos nyid la chags pa yin la/ de ltar gang zag gi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po'i nang nas rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi gang zag ni/ lam 'dir dngos su 'jug pa'i gang zag ma yin yang / brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'jug tu rung ba'i gang zag yin te/ stong thun chen mo las/ de ltar na rgyud gsum gyi gang zag ni/ dang por 'dus pa la dngos kyi gang zag ma yin yang / rgyud sde bzhi yang rgyud rgyal nyid du 'dus pas/ phyogs snga mar tshig gis bzung pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa dngos su 'jug pa'i gang zag ni/ spyir 'dod chags can gyi gang zag ste/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ gang gi don du 'di nyid mdzad/

/skye bo 'dod chags can don du/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de la yang gong du bshad pa ltar du ma yod pa las/ lam 'di la dngos su 'jug rung ba'i gang zag ni/ dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde bas ngoms pa'i chags can gyi gang zag ste/ de la yang shes rab la dga' ba dbang po brtul po dang / thabs la dga' ba dbang po rnon po gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni ma rgyud kyi rten gyi gang zag dang / gnyis pa ni lam 'di'i rten gyi gang zag yin te/ de skad du stong thun chen mo las/ de la 'di'i dngos kyi gang zag ni dbang po gnyis sbyor gyis ngoms pa'o/ /de yang shes rab la dga' ba dbang po brtul po dang / thabs la dga' ba dbang po rnon po'o/ /de la shes rab la dga' ba ni rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi gang zag ste/ da lta'i nyams myong gi sgo nas sems gnas pa tsam don du gnyer te zung 'jug mi slob pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa ma thob pa'i bar gyi lam gyi gnas skabs thams cad kyi ye shes 'char lugs dang / spangs bya spongs ba'i rims pa rgya chen po la mi mos pas na dbang po brtul po yin la/ 'di'i gang zag ni de lta bu la mos pas na thabs la dga' ba dang dbang po rnon po'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i thabs la dga' ba'i dbang po rnon po la yang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rnam pa kun du nyan 'dod pa'i/ /'jig rten nges par 'gyur ba yi/ /blo yi rnam pa dpag med las/ /gang zag rnam pa lngar 'dod do/ /utpal la dang pad dkar dang / /padma tsandan rin po che/ /rang bzhin tha dad ming gi ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar utpal lta bu'i gang zag padma dkar po lta bu'i gang zag tsandan lta bu'i gang zag rin po che lta bu'i gang zag dang lngar yod pa yin la/ de dag gi nang nas dang po bzhi po de dag ni tshogs bshad kyi yul mi mkhas pa'i gang zag yin te/ ji skad du rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/

utpal la dang pad dkar dang / /padma tsandan nyid dag ste/ /gang zag bzhi po 'di dag nyid/ /tshogs la bshad pa'i gang zag go /ces gsungs pas so/ /phyi ma rin po che lta bu'i gang zag ni/ slob ma la bshad pa'i gang zag gam slob bshad kyi snod yin te/ ji skad du de nyid las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i skal ldan zhing / /rtag tu spyod pas rnam brgyan pa/ /'di ni rin chen gang zag ste/ /slob ma la bshad snod yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /lnga po de dag gi mtshan nyid dam khyad chos rnams kyang zhib tu bshad na/ dang po utpal la lta bu'i gang zag ni/ thos pa mang zhing thos dus su don go ba cung zhig na brjed par 'gyur ba/ ma brjed kyi bar du rang gis ji ltar rtogs pa bzhin gzhan la ston nus pa ste mtshan nyid gsum ldan zhig yin te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan las/ de ni ma lus thos 'gyur la/ /'dzin pa la ni rnam par mkhas/ /skad cig gis ni brjed gyur pa/ /utpal zhes bya'i gang zag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa padma dkar po lta bu'i gang zag la yang mtshan nyid dam khyad par gyi chos gsum ste/ thos pa mang zhing thos dus su don go ba/ go ba de brjed par mi 'gyur bas/ gzhan la ston mi nus pa'o/ /de ltar rgyud de nyid las/ gzung bya mang du thos gyur kyang / /ston pa yi ni nus med pa/ /bum pa'i ras bal sa bon 'dra/ /pad dkar zhes bya'i gang zag go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa padma dmar po lta bu'i gang zag la yang khyad par chos sam/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du gsungs pa yin te/ dad pa che zhing kun gyi yid du 'ong ba/ sems can la snying rje che ba/ thos pa che ba/ thos don de ma thag brjed par 'gyur ba ste bzhi ldan du bshad pas so/ /de ltar yang / dad dang ldan zhing snying rje shes/ /thos nas blo yi kha dbye zhing / /tshigs med 'od ma bzhi 'bab pa/ /pad dmar zhes bya'i gang zag go /ces gsungs so/ /bzhi pa tsandan lta bu'i gang zag ni chos lnga ldan ste/

gsung rab thos rgya chung ba/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal che ba/ don gyi rtsa ba med pa ste blo gros sam snying stobs zhan pa/ tshig gi spros pa mang ba/ slob ma la tshul bzhin ston mi nus pas/ gdul bya rjes su bzung mi nus pa rnams yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang stong thun chen mo las/ tsandan lta bu la chos lnga ste/ /thos pa chung ba dang / nga rgyal che ba dang / don gyi rtsa ba med pa dang / tshig gi spros pa mang ba dang / /slob ma la legs par ston mi nus pas rjes su bzung du med pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ thos pa chung zhing nga rgyal ldan/ /rtsa ba med pa mang du smra/ /tsandan zhes bya'i gang zag go /ces gsungs pas so/ /don gyi rtsa ba med pa zhes pa 'di la/ 'ga' zhig las tshul khrims med pa zhes bshad/ de ltar na tsandan lta bu'i gang zag sdom ldan med par 'dod dgos la/ de 'dra'i gang zag med pa'i dmigs bsal gang du yang ma byung bas/ gang zag 'di bzhi char la sdom pa dang ldan mi ldan gnyis gnyis yod snyam la/ des na don gyi rtsa ba med pa zhes pa snying stobs zhan pa lta bu la 'thad dam snyam ste dpyad par bya'o/ /lnga pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag ni chos bdun ldan zhig yin te/ tshul khrims dag pa/ mkhas pa/ sgrin pa shes rab che ba/ rgyud gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ thos pa che ba/ don gzhan la ston nus pa'i yon tan rnams dang ldan pa zhig yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang stong thun chen mo las/ rin po che lta bu la bdun te/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing rang bzhin gyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / mkhas pas gzhan la phan 'dogs pa dang / bsgrin pas gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa dang / shes rab che bas chos thams cad kyi spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid shes pa dang / rgyud mi 'gyur bas dgos pa dang bya ba'i don thams cad mthar phyin pa dang / thos pa che bas sde snod mtha' dag gi don shes pa dang /

blo gsal bas gzhan 'dod pa'i chos thams cad ston nus pa'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la bsgrin/ /shes rab ldan zhing rgyud gcig la/ /thos nas legs par ston pa ni/ /rin chen zhes bya'i gang zag go /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag gi khyad chos gsum pa bsgrin pa zhes pa 'di la/ paṇa chen nyi zla seng ge'i rnam bshad las bsgrin pa ste khong grung ba zhes bshad/ ngo bo bzang po'i yon tan yin nam snyam ste/ khyad chos dang po la tshul khrims dag pa dang / gnyis pa la mkhas pa dang / gsum pa la bsgrin pa gsum rim can du bshad pas/ khyad chos dang po gsum mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan la sbyar bar snang ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ bsgrin pas gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa bzang po'i yon tan du 'chad dgos pas so snyam ste dpyad par bya'o/ /'o na de lta bu'i gang zag lnga char gyi rgyud 'di nyan bshad bsgrub gsum byar rung ngam snyam na/ utpal la lta bu'i gang zag dang / padma dmar po lta bu'i gang zag gnyis kyi ni bag chags tsam bzhag pas nyan du rung gis/ bshad bsgrub gnyis mi rung ste/ tshig don brjed nas med pa'i phyir/ padma dkar po lta mu dang / tsandan lta bu'i gang zag gnyis kyi ni nyan pa dang bsgrub par rung gis/ bshad du mi rung ste/ dang pos gzhan la gtan nas ston mi nus shing / gnyis pas tshig gi spros pa che bar ston kyang / tshig gi spros pa shin tu che ba'i stobs kyi gang zag gzhan gyi tshig don 'dzin mi nus pas so/ /lnga pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag ni nyan bshad bsgrub gsum thams cad rung ba yin te/ nyan du rung ba la ni rtsod pa med la/ bshad du rung ste/ thos pa che bas sde snod mtha' dag gi tshig don thos shing / shes rab che bas chos thams cad kyis rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyin phyin ci ma log par rtogs/

blo gsal bas gzhan 'dod pa'i chos thams cad legs par ston nus pa'i phyir/ yang 'gos kyi stong thun gyi dpe 'ga' zhig las/ nyan bshad du rung mi rung gi mtshan nyid la lnga ste/ utpal lta bu 'chad pa por rung / pad dkar lta bu bsgrub pa por rung / pad dmar lta bu nyan pa po rung / tsandan lta bu thams cad du mi rung / rin chen lta bu thams cad du rung ba'o/ /zhes tsandan lta bu'i gang zag gis nyan bshad bsgrub gsum gang yang mi rung bar bshad pa dang / tsandan lta bu'i gang zag gsang ba 'dus pa'i dngos kyi gdul byar stong thun nyid las bshad pa gnyis ma mthun pa ltar snang bas/ des na tsandan lta bu'i gang zag gis nyan bshad bsgrub gsum gang yang mi rung bar bshad pa 'di yi ge ma dag gam snyam mo/ /'o na gang zag de dag la utpal lta bu sogs zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ de yang bshad par bya ste/ utpal lta bu ni/ me tog utpal dang 'dra bas na de skad ces bya ste/ me tog utpal la de shin tu che zhing rtsi mang ba dang / nyi ma shar ba na kha bye zhing bung ba sogs pas rtsi blang bar nus pas/ rtsi de nyid 'dzag skyen pa bzhin du utpal lta bu'i gang zag 'di yang / thos pa che zhing thos don go ba/ ma brjed kyi bar du gzhan la ston nus pa/ thos nas cung zhig na brjed par 'gyur ba yin pas so/ /de yang 'dra chos so sor sbyar na/ utpal de me tog shin tu che zhing rtsi mang ba bzhin du/ gang zag 'di yang thos rgya che zhing thos don go ba/ utpal de nyi ma shar ba na kha bye zhing gzhan bud ba la sogs pas rtsi blangs nus pa bzhin du/ gang zag 'di yang ma brjed kyi bar ma rang gi gdul bya la ston nus pa/ me tog de rtsi 'dzag rkyen pa bzhin du gang zag 'dis kyang thos pa rnams cung zad na brjed par 'gyur bas/ des na gang zag dang po de la utpal dang 'dra bar bzhag pa yin no/ /de ltar yang stong thun chen po las/

nges tshig ni so so nas dbye ste/ ci'i phyir utpal la lta bu zhe na/ me tog utpal dang 'dra pas so/ /'dra chos gang gi 'dra na/ utpal la chos gsum ste/ che zhing rtsi mang ba dang / nyi ma shar bas kha bye zhing bung ba la sogs pas rtsi blangs par nus pa dang / rtsi de nyid 'dzag rkyen pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'o na padma dkar po lta bu'i gang zag de padma dkar po dang 'dra chos ji ltar zhe na/ de yang padma dkar po de nyid me tog che zhing rtsi mang ba dang / rtsi de nyid mi 'dzag pa dang / nyi ma shar ba na me tog kha zum nas bung ba la sogs pas rtsi blangs bar mi nus pa bzhin du/ gang zag gnyis pa 'di yang thos pa mang zhing thos dus su don go ba/ go ba de brjed par mi 'gyur ba/ gzhan la ston mi nus pas na de la de skad ces bya ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ ci'i phyir pad dkar lta bu zhe na/ me tog pas dkar dang 'dra pas so de la 'dra chos gsum ste/ me tog che zhing rtsi mang ba dang / rtsi de nyid mi 'dzag pa dang / nyi mas dros na kha zum zhing bung ba la sogs pas blang bar mi nus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bzhin du gang zag gsum pa la padma dmar po lta bu zhes brjod pa yang 'dra chos 'di dag gi yin te/ padma dmar po de kha dog dmar ba dang / kun gyi yid du 'ongs ba dang / nyi ma shar ba na kha bye zhing rtsi mang ba dang / rtsi de yang tshigs med pa'i 'od ma bzhin du skad cig la 'dzag par 'gyur ba bzhin du/ gang zag gsum pa 'di yang dad pa che zhing kun gyi yid du 'ong ba/ sems can la snying rje che ba/ thos pa che ba/ thos don de ma thag brjed par 'gyur bas na padma dmar po dang 'dra bar gsungs pa yin te/ stong thun las/ ci'i phyir pad dmar lta bu zhe na/ me tog pad dmar dang 'dra bas so/ /de la 'dra chos bzhi ste/ kha dog dmar ba dang / kun gyi yid du 'ong ba dang / nyi ma shar bas kha bye zhing rtsi mang ba dang /

tshigs med pa'i 'od ma bzhin du skad cig la 'dzag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gang zag bzhi pa la tsandan lta bu zhes pa yang / tsandan sbrul gyi snying po dang 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ ji ltar 'dra ba'i tshul ni/ tsandan sbrul gyi snying po de dngos po chung ba dang / dri ngad che ba dang / rtsa ba ngan par yod pa dang / yan lag mang ba dang / sbrul gyis dkris pas gzhan gyis len par mi nus pa ste chos bzhi ldan yin pa bzhin du gang zag 'di yang thos pa chung ba/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal che ba/ don gyi rtsa ba med pa/ tshig gi spros pa mang ba/ slob ma la tshul bzhin ston mi nus pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yin la/ de skad du yang stong thun las/ ci'i phyir tsandan lta bu zhe na/ tsandan sbrul gyi snying po dang 'dra bas so/ /de la chos lnga ste dngos po chung ba dang / dri che ba dang / rtsa ba ngan pa dang / yan lag mang ba dang / sbrul gyis dkris nas gzhan gyi len par mi nus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gang zag lnga pa 'di la rin po che lta bu zhes bya ba ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ 'dra chos kyang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che de nyid rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dgos 'dod skong ba dang / rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa dang / kun gyi yid du 'ong ba dang / gzhan la phan 'dogs pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa gtan mi byed pa dang / 'di la brten nas dgos 'dod 'byung ba rnams kyang / sgyu ma'i rta glang lta bu ma yin par thams cad la phan 'dogs nus pa ste/ khyad par gyi chos bdun dang ldan pa bzhin du/ gang zag 'di yang tshul khrims dag pa/ mkhas pa/ bsgrin pa/ shes rab che ba/ rgyud rkyen dbang gis gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa/ thos pa che ba/ thos don gzhan la ston nus pa ste/ khyad chos bdun dang ldan pa yin te/ stong thun las/ ci'i phyir rin po che lta bu zhe na/

yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra bas so/ /de la 'dra chos bdun te/ rang gzhan gyi dag pa dang / sems can kun gyi dgos 'dod skong ba dang / sbyor ba dang rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba dang / kun gyi yid du 'ongs pa dang / gzhan la phan 'dogs pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa dang / dgos 'dod sgyu ma'i rta glang lta bu ma yin par kun la phan 'dogs par nus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de rnams kyis rgyud la 'jug pa'i rten gyi gang zag gi rnam gzhag zhib tu bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa lam spyi'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa la don tshan lnga ste/ sbyang gzhi rang bzhin gyi chos/ sbyang bya mi mthun pa'i dri ma/ dmigs yul gang la dmigs pa/ nyams su len pa'i thabs/ mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa las/ skye ba kun rdzob bden pa zhes bya ste/ /'chi ba yang ni don dam bden pa yin/ /bden gnyis 'di dag rnam par nges byas nas/ /bshad pa gnyis kyi dbye ba gsungs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi dang / rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten dang / bcud kyi sems can skye ba gtso bor gyur pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum yin te/ ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul yang 'og gzhung don gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi ni/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba gtso bor gyur pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ skye ba kun rdzob bden pa dang / /'chi ba don dam bden pa gnyis/ /rim pa bzhin du bskyed rim dang / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyang gzhi yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa sbyang bya mi mthun pa'i dri ma ni/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad yin zhing / de yang cung zad phye na/ dngos po la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa/ gzung 'dzin bya byed kyi rtog pa/

dngos po'i ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa ste gsum dang / gsum po re re la yang rags pa dang phra ba gnyis gnyis te drug tu yod cing / drug po de dag kyang bskyed rim dang / lus dben dang / ngag dben dang / sems dben dang / sgyu ma dang / 'od gsal dang / zung 'jug rnams nyams su blangs pas spong ste/ stong thun las/ dri ma rnam dag gsum yin te/ /tha mal gzung 'dzin ngo bo'i rtog /re re'ang phra rags gnyis gnyis te/ /rim bzhin bskyed rim lus dben dang / /ngag dang sems dben sgyu ma dang / /'od gsal zung 'jug dag gis 'joms/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na sbyang gzhi dang / sbyang bya gnyis so sor 'byed dgos te/ sbyang gzhi ni sbyong byed lam gyi sbyang gzhi gang yin pa de'i steng gi dri ma de sbyangs nas/ sbyang 'bras kyi ngo bor bsgyur ba yin la/ sbyang bya'i dri ma ni/ sbyong byed lam gyi sbyang gzhi gang yin gyi steng du med par byed pa'am dag par byed dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs nas stong thun chen mo las/ 'o na sbyang gzhi sbyong ba dang / spang bya spong ba la khyad par ci yod ce na/ sbyong ba ni gnas dang / lus dang / longs spyod tha mal pa'i zhen pa mi spong bar gnas bsgyur ba tsam yin la/ spong ba ni rang gi sems myong ba gsal ba'i rgyun la zhen pa'i sa bon gcod pa'i kha lo mngon 'gyur gyi zhen pa mi 'byung bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /mdor bsdu na spang bya'i rnam rtog la tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang / gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog gnyis su grangs nges/ spong byed kyi gnyen po la yang tha mal gyi rnam rtog spong ba'i spong sems dang / gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog spong ba'i spong sems gnyis su grangs nges pa yin no/ /gsum pa dmigs par bya ba'i yul ni/ spang bya'i skyon kun spangs/ 'thob bya'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang dam pa de nyid yin la/

de nyid mngon du gyur pa na 'bras bu thob pa zhes kyang bya ste/ dper na 'jig rten pa dag gi so nam byed pa yang / dmigs yul ston thog la dmigs pas/ ston thog lag tu long ba la so nam byas pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas par 'jog pa bzhin no/ /de skad du stong thun chen mo las/ dper na 'bras bu ston thog la dmigs pas so nam byed pa rgyu mtshan du 'gro la/ dmigs yul de lag tu thob pa so nam byas pa'i 'bras bu yin pa ltar/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la dmigs nas nyams su len pa la 'jug pa'i rgyur 'gro la/ dmigs yul du bzhag pa de mngon du gyur pa ni 'bras bur 'gro'o/ /zhes dang / dmigs yul du rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i thabs la/ smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis su yod de/ ji skad du/ gang phyir rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /gsungs pa de ni gnyis su 'dod/ /smin lam dang ni grol lam mo/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'o/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces pa dang / rgyud phyi ma las/ bla ma sngags kyi lam gyis ni/ /slob ma yongs su smin par byas/ /slob ma bzang po bdag nyid de/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /ston pa yongs su grol ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar smin grol gnyis pa de ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba lta bu yin te/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya/ /zhes dang / des na smin byed dbang dang ni/ /rim pa gnyis la 'bad par gyis/ /zhes pa dang / dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi nang nas dang po smin lam mam/ smin byed kyi dbang bshad na/ lam 'di la ming gi rnam grangs du ma zhig gsungs te/

smin byed dang / rab tu gnas pa dang / dbang bskur ba zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /de yang ci'i phyir smin byed ces bya zhe na/ gang zag sngar dbang gis rgyud ma smin zhing / dbang bskur na rgyud smin du rung ba zhig la smin byed 'di bskur bas dngos grub rab 'bring tha gsum 'grub pa'i snod du rung bar byas pas de skad ces bya ste/ dper na lus kyi rma smin pa brtol du rung ba dang / zas smin pa bzar rung / btung ba smin pa 'thung du rung ba dang / shing thog smin pa longs spyad du rung ba bzhin no/ /de ltar yang rdo rje snying po rgyan las/ rma dang zas la ci lta bar/ /rnal 'byor smin pa'i lam yang de bzhin te/ /zhes dang / stong thun chen mo las/ rma smin pa brtol du rung / zas smin pa bzar rung / shing thog smin pa longs spyad du rung ba ltar/ sngags dang phyag rgyas rgyud smin par byas na dngos grub bsgrub pa'i snod du rung bas so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang smin byed la rab tu gnas pa zhes kyang bya ste/ slob ma sngar dbang ma thob pa'i sems rgyud dbang bskur ba'i sgo nas rab tu gnas par byas na shes rab rnam pa gsum gyi snod du rung bas so/ /dper na rdza gsar pa mes bsregs pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas na chu la sogs pa blug pa'i snod du rung ba bzhin no/ /de skad du yang stong thun chen mo las/ kha cig las rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes gsungs te/ dper na rdza ma mes gnas shing brtan par byas na chu la sogs pa blug pa'i snod du rung ba ltar/ sngags dang phyag rgyas rgyud gnas par byas na shes rab rnam gsum gyi snod du rung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /yang smin byed de nyid la dbang zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngar 'di ma thob pa'i gang zag cig gis 'di thob phyin chad nas bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gnyis bsgom pa dang / sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / rgyud 'chad pa la sogs pa la dbang zhing gnang ba thob par byas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/

ji skad du ston thun chen mo las/ kha cig las dbang bskur ba'i cho ga zhes gsungs te/ de la yang 'gal ba med de/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom pa dang / bzlas pa dang / bshad pa la dbang ngam gnang ba thob par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu dbang la yang smin byed la 'jug pa'i yan lag dang smin byed kyi dbang dngos gnyis/ dang po la rgyu yi rkyen khyad par can/ bdag po'i rkyen khyad par can/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen khyad par can/ dmigs pa'i rten khyad par can dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gang la dbang bskur ba'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ dge ba sdom la dga' ba dang / /rtag tu bla ma la gus dang / /rtag tu lha rnams mchod pa yi/ /yon tan ldan na slob ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba la sems spro ba/ dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba la dga' ba/ rtag tu bla ma la gus pa/ rtag tu rang gi lhag pa'i lha mchod pa la mos pa rnams kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig ste/ de yang 'di'i yon tan la dge ba la spro ba dgos te/ dge ba la sems spro ba med na chos la 'jug par mi 'gyur zhing / chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu dge ba la spro ba yod kyang / dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba la dga' ba'i sems med na/ dam tshig dang sdom pa thob kyang myur du nyams par 'gyur bas/ de dag bsrung ba la yang dga' spro dang ldan pa dgos la/ yon tan de gnyis dang ldan kyang / bla ma la dad gus kyi sems med na/ dam tshig dang sdom pa sogs bla mas bstan kyang rang rgyud la byin rlabs mi 'jug pas na/ dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma la mos gus dang ldan pa zhig kyang gtso bor dgos shing / yon tan de dag dang ldan kyang rang gi lhag pa'i lha la mchod pa la mos pa'i sems med pa na/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snod du mi rung zhing / khyad par lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba'i snod du mi rung bas na yon tan dang po gsum gyi steng du 'di dang nges par ldan dgos te/

snga ma gsum dang ldan pa tsam ni ches mang ba'i phyir ro/ /mdor bsdu na sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pas rgyud sbyangs te/ 'di'i dbang bskur dang dam tshig 'bog par 'os pa'i gang zag skal ldan zhig la rgyu'i rkyen khyad par can du 'jog pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bdag po'i rkyen khyad par can ni/ gang gis dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ de yang rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing / /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /de ni slob dpon yin zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang bzhin rgyud kyi khyad par/ 'dus byas pa yon tan gyi khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thugs rgyud rkyen dbang cung zad tsam gyis gzhan du mi 'gyur bas brtan pas dang nyon mongs drag po'i dbang du mi btang bas rgyud dul ba/ chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes pas blo gros dang ldan pa/ khong khro ba med pas bzod pa dang ldan pa/ sems la ya yo med pas drang ba/ pha rol po la bslu sems sogs med pas g.yo sgyu med pa dang drug yin la/ gnyis pa 'dus byas la yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ 'phrin las bzhi la sogs pa'i sngags kyi sbyor ba dang / mtha' drug dang / gdams ngag drug dang / yan lag lnga la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba ste/ de rnams legs par shes pa/ de nyid bcu shes pa/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams yin la/ de dag gi nang nas de nyid bcu la/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ phyir bzlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang / /gsang dang shes rab ye shes dang / /kha sbyor dbye pa'i cho ga dang / /gtor ma rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /drag shul bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang / /rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor bsgrub/

/gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes gsang ba'i de kho na nyid bcu dang / yang de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /stangs stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin sreg mchod pa las sbyor dang / /slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa ni/ /phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes phyi'i de nyid bcu dang / yang rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni ting 'dzin mchog /phyag rgya stangs stabs gdan dang ni/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg mchod pa dang / /las ma sbyar dang slar bsdu ba'o/ /zhes cho ga'i de kho na nyid bcu dang / yang bla ma yongs bzung gi rgyud las/ gnas dang dus dang lha dang sngags/ /bgrang phreng phyag rgya'i sbyin sreg dang / /dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas kyi/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /zhes rdo rje slob dpon la nye bar mkho ba'i de kho na nyid bcu dang / yang rin chen 'bar ba las/ rdo rje dril bu ye shes dang / /lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /sngags dang rdul tshon gtor ma dang / /dbang bskur de nyid bcu pa'o/ /zhes de kho na nyid kyi de nyid bcu la sogs pa rnam grangs mang du gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid la rgyud dang bstan bcos rnams las mang du gsungs te/ dgra nag gi rgyud las/ snying rje ldan zhing nyes pa ma lus spangs/ /bsam gtan la brtson bzlas la mchog gzhol ba/ /de 'dra'i bla ma la ni rtag tu bla mar bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas snying po rgyan las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing / /zhes dang / rdo rje phreng ba las/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa bsrung / /nang du 'dus pa'i don la mkhas/ /zhes dang / rje btsun rin po ches/ bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan rgyud don rig

/dam tshig mchog bsrung man ngag du mas brgyan/ /snying rjes rgyud brlan bstan bcos du ma shes/ /de yi zhabs brtan gsol ba lan mang btab/ /ces pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa yin no/ /de thams cad kyi snying po bsdus nas bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur yang / /bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing / /cho ga 'khrul par ma gyur pa/ /phyi nang rten 'brel sgrig mkhyen zhing / /sku bzhi'i sa bon theb nus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig yin la/ yang na/ khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas/ /gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad/ /ces pa ltar gang la gang 'dul gyi skur bstan nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs dang mthun pa dang / byang sems kyi theg pa theg chen gyi mdo sde dag nas bshad pa ltar dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde dang mthun pa thugs nyams su bzhes shing gzhan la'ang ston pa ste/ mdor na so so'i cho ga dang / lhag par dbang dus su thob pa'i thugs rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa/ bsnyen pa las su rung ba/ de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang / 'di'i cho ga la mkhas pa sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig bdag po'i rkyen khyad par can du 'jog pa yin te/ don 'di 'dra'i rigs la dgongs nas mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇḍi tas/ so so thar pa 'dul ba bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' mdo sde bzhin/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhin ston pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen khyad par can ni/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir du rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pa byed pa ste/ 'di la sngon du 'gro ba bsnyen pa/

sa'i cho ga sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rab yi dam lha'i gnang ba thob pa zhig yin te/ dgyes rdor gyi rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'bring mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ste/ klu sgrub kyi dkyil chog nyi shu pa las/ mtshan ma nges par thob pa 'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /tha ma bzlas brjod grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ de yang gtso bo la 'bum/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re 'dren pa yin te/ dkyil chog de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor bdag po bzlas pa 'bum/ /de las zhan pa khri ru bzlas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa sa'i chog la/ sa brtag pa dang / blang ba dang / sbyang ba dang / gzung ba dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang / bsrung ba dang drug las/ dang po la steng brtag pa/ 'og brtag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i steng ni zlum po'am padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbyibs su yod na shis pa yin te/ stong thun chen mo las/ steng ni zlum po dang padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'og brtag pa la/ phyogs mtshams brtag pa/ nus pa brtag pa/ yul phyogs brtag pa/ kha dog brtag pa/ tshad brtag pa dang lnga las/ dang po la dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i 'og gzhi'i sa ni/ nub kyi phyogs mtho ba/ byang skyob pa 'dra ba/ lho bris pa 'dra ba/ shar gzhol ba'am brdal ba 'dra ba dang / mtshams ni byang shar nas 'byung po'i rkan mes 'jab pa 'dra ba yod na mi shis pa de med pa/ shar lho na ma mo khros pa'i par rjes 'dra ba yod na sa dgra yin pas de yang med pa/ lho nub na srin po khros pa'i par shul 'dra ba med pa/ nub byang na gnod sbyin gyi 'dug stegs 'dra ba med pa sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan mi ldan brtag dgos te/ stong thun chen mo las/ 'og la lnga/ phyogs mtshams brtag pa ni/ nub mtho ba/ byang skyobs pa/ lho bris pa/ shar gzhol ba'o/ /mtshams ni byang shar nas 'byung po'i 'jab pa med pa/

lho shar nas ma mo khros pa'i par rjes med pa/ lho nub na srin po khros pa'i par shul med pa/ nub byang nas gnod sbyin 'dug stegs med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa nub sa brtag pa ni/ chu 'dzin nam sprin kha dog gtso cher dkar ba zhig yod na de nyid legs pas/ de dang ldan mi ldan brtag pa ste/ stong thun las/ nus pa ni chu 'dzin pa'i kha dog dkar ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa yul phyogs brtag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du 'bri ba'i grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gang yin kyang / de dag gi byang shar du bri ba shis pa yin te/ stong thun las/ yul phyogs brtag pa ni/ grong ngam grong khyer ram gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i byang shar mtshams su bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa kha dog brtag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa de kha dog dkar po yod na zhi ba'i las gtso bor 'grub pa dang / ser por yod na rgyas pa'i las gtso bor 'grub pa dang / dmar por yod na dbang gi las gtso bor 'grub pa dang / nag por yod na mngon spyod dam drag po'i las gtso bor 'grub pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs par yod na las bzhi sna tshogs pa 'grub par 'gyur bas na/ las so so dang bstun pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa gzhi'i kha dog kyang so sor brtag dgos pa yin te/ de ltar byas na las so so myur du 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod pas so/ /de lta yang stong thun las/ kha dog brtag pa ni/ zhi ba'i sa ni dkar po la sogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /lnga pa tshad brtag pa ni/ che ba dpag tshad nas/ chung ba khru drug gi bar yan chad 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i ci rigs pa rung gis/ dpag tshad las rgya che ba dang / khru drug gi tshad las chung ba ni mi rung ste/ dpag tshad las ni che mi bya/ /khru drug las ni chung mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lag tu blang bde ba'i tshad ma 'khrul ba ni/ rgyud le'u bcu drug pa las/

de nas sku yi dkyil 'khor mchog /khru ni bcu drug tshad du bya/ /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor mchog /khru ni nyi shu'i tshad du bya/ /zhes dang / le'u bzhi pa las/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /khru ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i rgyar khru nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i rgyar sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i rgyar khru bzhi bcur bya dgos te/ stong thun chen mo las/ tshad brtag pa ni 'byor pa che chung gis shes par bya ste/ zhes spyir bstan gyi tshul du gsungs nas/ dmigs bsal gyi tshul du sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa ni/ bcu drug nyis 'gyur du bya/ gnyis po yang nyis 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa sa slang ba la/ snang ba mi la slang ba dang / /mi snang ba lha ma yin la sogs la slang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yul phyogs de'i bdag po rgyal po la sogs pa la slang la/ de dag gis kyang gyis shig pa'i gnang ba thob na der dkyil 'khor bya zhing / gnang ba thob pa ma yin na mi rung ste/ rgyal po ma rung pa lta bus slar dkyil 'khor grub nas bar chad byed pa srid pas so/ /de ltar yang stong thun chen mo las/ gnang ba mi la slang ba ni rgyal po la sogs pa de'i bdag po la gnang ba thob pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa mi snang ba lha dang lha ma yin sogs la slang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du byed pa'i sa phyogs der maṇḍal dang / me tog gi tshom bu dang / mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa bsham ste byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma byin nas bar snang la gnas pa'i lha dang / lha ma yin dang / mi ma yin mthu bo che sogs las slong ba ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ mi snang ba la slang ba ni/ lha dang / lha min dang / mi ma yin pa la slong ba ste/ dkyil 'khor byed pa'i sa der dgong mo maṇḍal bya/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod nas mchod pa bsham la gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la gtor ma byin/

nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i lha klu gnod sbyin lha ma yin/ gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sa phyogs dben pa 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /'di zhes bya ba 'bri lags na/ /bdag la bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /ces pas bsgos la nyal nas rmi lam brtag par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar byas na rmi lam du byin pa'i snang ba byung na der 'bri rung / ci ste gnang ba ma byin na zhag bdun gyi bar du gong ltar byas pas da gzod gnang ba ster na der bgegs zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya dgos shing / der ma zad bdag nyid dang / slob ma dang / sa bdag la sogs pa la yang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sogs grub na legs par gsungs te/ stong thun chen mo las/ gal te gnas der byed pa'i gnang ba ma byin na zhag gcig nas bdun gyi bar du de ltar bya'o/ /de ltar gnang ba ster na gnas der ji skad bshad pa'i longs spyod kyi bgegs zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas bdag dang / slob ma dang / sa bdag la sogs pa la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa sa sbyang ba la gsum ste/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba/ rdzas dang yo byad kyis sbyang ba/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa 'og 'dom gang ngam/ khru gang ngam/ pus nub tsam brkos la/ sa'i ro'am skyon drug bsal dgos te/ de yang dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa de'i 'og na yod pa'i srog chags kyi ro rus pa dang / gos kyi ro re ba/ lhan tshal sogs dang / 'bru'i ro phub ma dang / shing gi ro thal sol dang / rdo'i ro pha bong dang / seg ma ste bye ma dang / sa'i ro gyo dum rnams te/ de yang yod med brtags nas yod pa rnams dor dgos pas so/ /ma bsal na nyes pa ci yod snyam na/ drug po de ma dor na/

rim pa bzhin du gzer nad dang / 'gras phol dang / rims nad dang / tshad rims dang / zha grum dang / lkugs pa rnams 'byung bas de dag med par bya dgos te/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo las/ gsum pa sa gzhi sbyang ba ni gsum ste/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba ni khor yug 'dom gang tsam khru gang ngam/ pus mo nub tsam brkos la sa'i ro drug sel te/ srog chags kyi ro rus pa ma bsal na gzer nad 'byung / gos kyi ro re ba ma bsal na 'gras phol 'byung / 'bru'i ro phur ma ma bsal na rims nad 'byung / shing gi ro thal sol ma bsal na tsha rims 'byung / rdo'i ro rdo pha bong dang seg ma ma bsal na zha grum 'byung / sa'i ro gyo dum ma bsal na lkug pa 'byung / de ni brko sogs kyi sbyong ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa rdzas dang yo byad kyis sbyang ba ni/ tsandan dang gur gum la sogs pa dri bzang gi chus chag chag 'debs pa sa gzhi'i mi gtsang ba rnams bkru ba ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ gnyis pa rdzas dang yo byad kyi sbyang ba ni/ tsandan dang gur gum gyi chus gtor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyang ba ni/ sa de'i dbus su maṇḍal bkod/ me tog sil ma bkram la lha'i gnas dang gdan ji lta ba bzhin bsgom zhing de'i steng du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams rdzogs par bskyed/ de la ye shes pa dgug gzhug byas nas bstim/ byin gyis brlabs shing dbang bskur/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang / slob ma rnams la nyan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri bar 'tshal na/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gzhan yang phyogs skyong bcu bskyed/ gtor ma phul/ de nas lha so gnyis kyi bdag bskyed bsgoms nas khro bo gnod mdzes kyi sngags kyis bgegs bskrad nas sa'i bgegs sogs sbyong ba ste/

stong thun chen mo las/ gsum pa sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyang ba ni/ sa de'i dbus su maṇḍal gru bzhi khru gang pa gcig byas la/ me tog sil ma bkram la lha'i gnas dang gdan ji lta ba bzhin du bsam ste/ bla ma dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed la ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug bcing ba byas te bstim/ byin brlab dbang bskur ba byas la de la phyi nang gsang bas mchod bstod byas la/ dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la sman slad du/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa 'bri bar 'tshal/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas phyogs skyong bcu rang rang gi gnas su bskyed nas gtor ma sbyin/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis sa gzhi de'i steng du lha so gnyis rdzogs par bsgoms pa'i mthar gnod mdzes kyi sngags kyis bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa sa gzhi bsrung ba ni/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig g.yas g.yon du ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba bsgom/ de'i dbus su mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa khro bo'i 'od zer gyi snang ba phyogs bcur 'phros/ de'i nam mkha'i khams thams cad khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyis khyab par yid kyis sprul/ rang gi lag pa g.yas g.yon du rdo rje dang dril bu 'gying bag tu 'dzin pas/ dkyil 'khor byed pa'i sa gzhi de la byang shar nas brtsams te stangs stabs kyi g.yas bskor lan gsum byas/ ngag tu/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes sogs brjod cing sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rjer byin gyis brlab/ de nas seng lding gi phur pa stod zhal gsum phyag drug pa khro bo'i rnam pa can/ smad zur gsum rtse gcig pa'i tshul can zhig dri bzang pos byugs/

me tog dmar po'i phreng ba btags byin gyis brlabs nas sa'i phyogs der legs par btab ste bsrung ba bya bar gsungs te/ stong thun chen mo las/ bzhi pa sa gzhi bzung ba ni/ dang po'i sbyor bas zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgom mo/ /rnam snang la sogs pa rigs bzhi'i phyogs bzhi na gnas pa'i las kyi rdo rje dngos sam/ yid kyis bsams kyang rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /la sogs pa le'u bzhi pa ltar gsol ba btab nas/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgoms la/ mig g.yas g.yon du ma dang ṭa gnyis las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom ste/ de'i dbus su mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po/ de las khro bo'i 'od zer gyi snang ba phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du'ang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyis khyab par sprul lo/ /rkang pa gnyis la a las rdo rje 'od 'bar bar bsgoms la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon du rdo rje dril bu 'gying bag tu 'dzin pas dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams te stangs stabs kyi g.yas bskor du lan gsum bskor/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin la sogs pa brjod cing sna tshogs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas seng lding gi phur bu dri zhim pos byugs la/ me tog dmar po'i phreng ba btags te/ stod zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ smad zur gsum rtse gcig par byin gyis brlabs pas phur pa gdab bo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /lnga pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐ zhes pas nam mkha'i khams/ de'i ngang nas hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ las 'byung ba bzhi bskyed/ de nas sbyor ba dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgoms nas sa'i phyogs de nyid byin gyis brlab pa ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ lnga pa byin gyis brlab ni/ hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐ las nam mkha'/ hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ la sogs pas 'byung ba bzhi bskyed/ oṃ badzra me dhi ni badzri bha wa bandha hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs so/

/de nas der sbyor ba gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom mo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /drug pa sa gzhi bsrung ba ni/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal pos sa gzhi de nyid kyi rwa ba dang drwa ba dang phyogs bzhi po bcings pa'i srung ba byed pa yin no/ /de ltar yang stong thun chen mo las/ drug pa sa gzhi bsrung ba ni/ 'dod pa'i rgyal pos rwa ba dang drwa ba dang phyogs bzhi bcing bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis sa'i cho ga bstan zin pa yin la/ de ltar sa chog gi rnam gzhag 'di dag gzhan du gsal ba cher mi 'byung yang / /'gos kyi stong thun chen mo las rgyas par gsungs pa rnams kyi don gsal bar bshad pa'i sgo nas zhib tu bkod pa yin no/ /gsum pa sta gon la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhir yod pa las/ dang po ni/ sa lha'i sgo nas mchod bsham/ bsang sbyang / so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ de nas oṃ pri thi wi zhes sogs kyi tshom bu bkod de/ de'i steng du sa lha bskyed/ rang gi lag mthil gyi hūm̐ bzhi'i 'od zer gyis sa 'og nas lha mo spyan drangs/ rdo rje lngas mchod nas bstim/ de la phyi nang gi mchod pa dang / gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas phul/ de nas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs brjod de/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsol cig par gsol ba btab la/ des kyang gnang ba byin par bsam zhing / sa'i lha mo sa de nyid du bstim/ yang rang gi lag pa bsdams pa las hūm̐ yig 'bar ba spros nas sa 'og gi bar rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ de yang sngags tshan gnyis pa tshar gsum re brjod pas brtan par bsam pa ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ sa'i lha mo sta gon la gnas pa ni/ mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya sa gnon du byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ ṭa ka ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod pas lha mo sku mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa spyi bor rnam snang gis brgyan pa/

lag na gser gyi bum pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas 'thon par bsam ste/ de la/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba btab la/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul la de nyid du bstim mo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa gzhi de nyid la bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri bzang gi chus byugs shing / lha so so'i sngags bdun nam gsum bzlas te gtso bo lnga'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang / gzhan rnams kyi gnas su dri'i thig le zlum po bya/ der gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed la/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyis 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas so so'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs par bsam la/ zhal phyag rnams rdzogs par gsal btab/ de la mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod lnga nas/ gsang mchod kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya ba ste/ stong thun chen mo las/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha sta gon la gnas pa ni/ bdud rtsi lnga dang dri zhim po'i chus lha'i grangs dang mthun pa'i thig le byas la/ gdan dang gzhal yas khang ji lta ba bzhin bsam ste/ phyag rgya dang gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig las dam tshig gi 'khor lo rdzogs par bkod la/ ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / bstim pa dag bya ste/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi mchod pas mchod cing bstod/ gsol ba lan gsum btab/ lag pas spos phor btegs te/ pus po sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs kyis lan gsum du snyan gsan byas la mchod pa byas nas rwa ba dang drwa bas phyogs dang mtshams bcing bar bya ste lha sta gon no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na sa skya pa'i dbang bka' rnying ma ltar na/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang bar snang gi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsam la/

mchod bstod bdud rtsi dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs la/ spos dang bcas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lce hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsams nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la byin gyis brlab par sangs rgyas la gsol ba btab pa 'di yang lha sta gon du gsungs nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig kyang / bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /zhes sogs bya bar gsungs la/ dbang bka' gsar ma'i lugs la/ 'di'i sngon du bum pa sta gon mdzad nas/ 'di sangs rgyas la gsol ba btab pa zhes don tshan gcig par bshad do/ /gang ltar gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ zangs la sogs pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rab lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ de ma 'byor na phyogs kyi lha la bzhi/ mtshams kyi lha la bzhi/ dbus kyi lha la gcig ste dgu'am/ de yang ma 'byor na phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga'am/ yang na rigs lnga la gcig yum la gcig sems dpa' rnams la gcig sems ma rnams la gcig khro bo rnams la gcig ste lnga byed pa'am/ de dag thams cad ma 'byor na/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa gcig dang / las bum gcig ste gnyis bsham la/ rnam rgyal la bum mtshan nyi ma'i steng du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa dang / las bum la nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa btags te/ bum pa gnyis gu gul gyis bdug las thams cad kyi sngags bzlas/ yungs kar gyis brab/ nang du bum rdzas la rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ sman lnga rnams sbyar ba dri bzang po'i chu dang sbyar la blugs te/ gzhan yang kha rgyan dang mgul chings dung chos sogs legs par bshams nas/ bum pa rnams bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang / shu n+ya tas stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par bskyed/ bum pa thams cad yod na so so lha so so dang / lha bum rnam rgyal las med na der lha thams cad bskyed/

las bum du bgegs mthar byed rnams so so'i sa bon las bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug dang / dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams byas la me tog phreng ba nas bzung / lha so so'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'bru gsum dang / oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ khrus kyi don du gtsug tor rnam rgyal lam/ phyi bzlog blo gros bzang mo'i gzungs nyer gcig bzla/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta zhes sogs nyer gcig bzlas/ sngar bzhin du mchod bstod byas nas gtso bo'i sngags dang hūm̐ bzlas pa'i dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams su blugs te phul bas/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes bzhus nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur te chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam mo/ /de nas las bum gyi chu dang / na mo badzra kro dha ya zhes sogs kyi phreng sngags kyis bsang la/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs pa de nyid du bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig ces brjod la las bum dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i shar sgor bzhag go /bum bzlas dang mchod pa ni nyi ma re la thun gsum du bya bar gsungs pa yin la/ don de dag stong thun chen mo las bstan tshul ni/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ gser ram 'khar ba'i rgyu las byung ba'i bum pa lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha khyer dang ldan pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ nag nog med pa/ lha'i grangs dang mthun pa bya/ zhes pas bum pa'i rgyu dang / dbyibs dang / grangs rnams bstan/ tsandan la sogs pas dkar por byugs shing padma la sogs pa'i gdan la so so rang rang mtshan ma bri/ zhes pas bum mtshan bya tshul bstan/ rab kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul chings bya/ tsu ta'i shing la sogs pa 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ zhes pas rgyan bstan/ dri chus gang ba/ gro dang / nas dang /

til dang / 'bras dang / mon sran gre'u ste 'bru lnga dang / byu ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dung dang / mu tig dang / nor bu ste rin po che lnga dang / seng gri bya kri/ ha sa de wa/ nad sel/ karṇi ka ste sman lnga blug la/ zhes pas bum pa'i nang gi bcud dam rdzas bstan/ me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa'i rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /zhes pas bum pa'i steng du dung chos bkod de bzlas pa bya tshul bstan/ yi ge baṃ las gser gyi bum par bsgom la/ hri las byung ba'i padma dang / a las byung ba'i zla ba dang / nyi ma'i gdan la rang rang gi sa bon du gyur pa las sku rdzogs pa la ye shes kyi 'khor lo bcug kyang / bstims te mchod yon dang mchod pa phul te gtor ma yang kha zas sbyangs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs nas so so'i bzlas pas bsnyen par bya'o/ /zhes pas bum pa bskyed pa'i nang du lha bskyed pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs bstims nas mchod pa dang / bzlas pa sogs bya ba'i tshul bstan/ de yang g.yas su rnam rgyal bum pa bzhag mi g.yo bar bsgom/ g.yon du las thams cad pa'i bum pa bzhag bdud rtsi 'khyil par byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa dang / bzlas pas mnyes par byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi bgegs bzlog tu gsol byas la las bcol lo/ /zhes pas bum pa gnyis rnal 'byor pa rang gi g.yas g.yon du 'god tshul dang / bgegs bzlog pa'i las 'chol tshul bstan pa ste/ bum pa sta gon gyi rnam gzhag gsal bar gsungs pa yin no/ /yang stong thun las/ sngar gyi de dag gi mjug de ma thag par/ dkyil 'khor la mchod pa yang bya/ snga ma ltar gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo/ /zhes gsungs pas bka' rnying ma'i lugs la snyan gsan dbab pa'am/ sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs pa bum pa sta gon gyi gong du gcig dang / bum bskyed kyi mjug tu yang bya bar bshad do/

/de ltar lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen khyad par can la bsnyen pa/ sa chog sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhig gi bya ba dang bzhi'i dang po gnyis dang / sta gon la sa lha/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhir yod pa'i dang po gsum po rnams ni rdo rje slob dpon kho nas bya ba'i las yin pas/ dbang bskur ba'i sngon du 'grub zin pa zhig dgos la/ 'di dag dang / dkyil 'khor thig gi bri ba dang / tshon gyi bri ba sogs 'og nas 'byung ba 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa rnams rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa yin la/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba thams cad la cho ga rgyas pa 'di dag thams cad nges par dgos pa ni ma yin te/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du yang smin byed rung zhing / de la cho ga rgyas pa rnams mi dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang smin byed dbang skur byed kyi dkyil 'khor la rnam grangs shin tu ches mang ba zhig bshad pa ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa rdo rje slob ma la gtso bor bya ba slob ma sta gon la/ spyir rgyud sde so so nas bshad pa'i ming 'dogs mi 'dra ba dang / cho ga'i rnam gzhag cung zad mi mthun pa mang du 'byung yang / slob ma sta gon gyi chos la don tshan bcu bzhir yod pa bla med kyi rgyud sde phal cher las 'byung zhing / bcu bzhi po'i ngo bo so so dang bskur tshul la yang mi mthun pa chen po med do/ /'on kyang dgyes rdor ltar na/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed/ /nang dbang bskur la khyad don zhu/ /spro ba bskyed de rgyun bshags bya/ /bsrung ba byas te mchod pas mchod/ /so shing dor la khyor chu blud/ /bsrung skud btags te ku sha sbyin/ /zab mo'i chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar lus kyi bya ba ste/ slob ma khrus byas phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas rang rang gi gral la 'khod nas/ slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba don tshan dang po dang /

de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs la lam gyi rtsa ba smin byed kyi dbang legs par nos nas dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom dang lam la ci nus kyi 'bad pa bgyi'o snyam pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pas nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed du gzhug pa don tshan gnyis pa/ de ltar nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed pas theg chen du rigs nges par byas pa de/ slar yang yi dam gyi lha'i rigs su nges par bya ba'i phyir dang / dbang gi dngos gzhi ma thob bar gyi gsang ba'i chos khyad par can rnams nyan pa'i snod rung dang / slob dpon la yang de dag gi skabs su gsang sgrog mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang / rang nyid skye ba'i tshe bar do'i rnam shes pha'i khar zhugs nas/ ma'i mngal du babs pa la/ pha'i khu ba 'bru gsum gyi sgras phog pas sems nyid bde ba'i ngo bor gnas pa'i rang chas kyi dbang yod pa de ngo 'phrod pa'i phyir du ston pa dga' ldan nas yum gyi lhums su zhugs te zla ba bcu de nyid du bde ba la longs spyod de/ mthar mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas bltams pa dang tshul mtshungs kyi sgo nas/ slob dpon yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal nas slob ma rnams zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi padmar babs pa skad cig gis he ru kar gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang nang dbang thob pa yin pas/ de nas slob dpon gyis hūm̐ brjod pa'i rkyen gyis slob ma rnams he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas rang rang gi gral la 'khod pa'i mos pa byed pa don tshan gsum pa/ de ltar khyad par can gyi chos zhu ba'i rigs su byin gyis brlab pa des/ khyad par can gyi chos stsal du gsol cig par snyim pa me tog dang bcas/

bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /zhes pa nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa don tshan bzhi pa yin la/ gsol btab kyi tshigs bcad 'di dag kyang 'gyur khyad cung zad ma gtogs/ rdo rje rtse mo/ sdom 'byung / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba rnams nas mthun par 'byung bas rgyud kyi tshig kho na yin zhing / rkang pa dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khyad par can gyi don zhu ba por byin gyis brlab pa dran pa'i phyir du/ bla ma gong ma dag gi man ngag gis bsnan pa yin par rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bshad la/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /zhes 'di brjod pas khyad par can gyi don zhu ba por dran pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / gong nang dbang bskur ba'i tshe khyad par can gyi don zhu ba por byin gyis brlabs pa yin te/ de yang bla ma kyai rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i sku lus kyi nang du slob ma rnams bcug bdag med ma'i mgrin pa nas 'khyud pa'i rnam pa can gyis/ bla ma'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ gis sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas slob ma la bstim pa la nang dbang bskur ba'i tha snyad gsungs shing / de nyid la brten nas slob ma rnams khyad par can gyi don zhu ba por gyur pa yin pas na de nyid/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /zhes pa 'di brjod pas dran par 'gyur ba yin nam snyam mo/ /gang ltar tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gi don cung zad bshad na/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes pa'i dga' chen zhes pa bod pa'i tshig ste/ de yang slob dpon la zag med kyi dga' ba chen po dang ldan pa zhes bos nas/ khyod ni bdag cag la bde ba chen po'i lam ston pa po'i slob dpon yin pas/ khyod ni bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du yud tsam zhig dgongs su gsol/ ci'i slad du zhe na/ mngon par byang chub pa chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i mgon po chen po sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshams pa'i slad du/

de'i lam gyi rtsa ba rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig ste sngags kyi dbang bskur ba'i sngags kyi sdom pa de nyid bdag la legs par stsol/ de'i rten du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshad kyi cho ga las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang bdag la stsol/ der ma zad de'i rten du sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i sgo nas so so thar pa'i sdom pa dag kyang bdag la stsol la nyan thos kyi thar pa/ rang rgyal gyi thar pa/ thar pa chen po ste gsum las/ phyi ma sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer mchog de nyid du mgon po ste slob dpon khyed kyis bdag ni gzhug tu gsol zhes pa'i don yin no/ /de nas yang gong nang dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ chos kyi bur byas zin pa de la/ bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos nas/ khyed rnams rdo rje theg pa'i snod yin pas/ kho bos rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing / khyad par 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yang lam 'di la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyang lam 'di dang mjal ba skal ba bzang ba yin pas blo gzhan du ma 'gyur ba gyis zhes pa'i spro ba bskyed pa'i tshigs bcad/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yis/ /zhes pa nas/ bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces pa'i bar brjod pa don tshan lnga pa/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags sam thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i slad du/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa ni don tshan drug pa yin no/ /'di'i skabs su thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sdom gnyis sngar ma thob na gsar du thob pa dang /

thob zin pa yar ldan du byed cing / nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin la/ de ltar thob pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ srog gcod rku dang 'khrig pa dang / /brdzun dang chang ni rnam spangs te/ /khyim pa'i sdom la legs gnas nas/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rab tu bsgrub/ /ces pa ltar rtsa ba bzhi chang dang lnga spong ba'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la 'jog pa yin te/ kun mkhyen rin po ches/ sta gon 'jug pa'i gnas skabs su/ /thob pas so thar sdom pa ni/ /dge bsnyen sdom par bla ma bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de nas slob ma rnams kyi gnas gsum du slob dpon gyi dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pa reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pa'i sgo nas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje ma gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de nyid ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ gnas gsum byin brlab mdzad pa ni don tshan bdun pa/ yang lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas ma chags par longs spyod cig ces slob ma rnams la brda sprad pa'i phyir mchod pa lngas mchod pa ni don tshan brgyad pa/ de nas rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ma dang ltas brtag pa'i phyir bum dbang gi sta gon so shing byin nas 'dor ba ni don tshan dgu pa/ gsang dbang gi snod rung du bya ba'i phyir gsang dbang gi sta gon khyor chu lud pa ni don tshan bcu pa/ de nas slob ma'i rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir dbang gsum pa'i sta gon du byin gyis brlab pa'i srung skud skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi g.yas la 'ching ba ni don tshan bcu gcig pa yin la/ de yang dpung pa g.yas g.yon so sor 'ching pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rnam snang mngon byang las skyes pa dang bud med so sor ma phye bar g.yon la 'ching bar bshad/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba las g.yas la 'ching bar bshad cing / rgya gzhung rnams las nges med cig gsungs kyang /

phyag len la 'di ltar mdzad pa ni/ skyes pa la khams dkar po la brten pa'i bar chad dang / bud med la khams dmar po la brten pa'i bar chad bsrung dgos pa shas che bas de'i ched du yin par gsungs pa yin no/ /yang rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang / dbang bzhi pa'i snod rung bya ba'i phyir dbang bzhi pa'i sta gon dag byed kyi rdzas ku sha slob ma'i sngas stan du byin pa ni don tshan bcu gnyis pa/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces pa nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod nas chos bshad de 'bras bu yang spro ba bskyed pa ni don tshan bcu gsum pa/ de nas slob ma'i rmi lam bzang ngan brtags nas/ bzang na sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gang yang rung ba thob par shes par byas nas zhen pa med pa dga' ba bsgom du gzhug ci ste ngan na bden med bsgom pa dang / rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bsrung ba dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor dang / zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la sogs pa rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa'i thabs la brtson pa byar gzhug pa ni don tshan bcu bzhi par bshad pa yin no/ /'khor lo bde mchog ltar sta gon gyi chos la/ slob ma slob dpon gyi 'os su gyur ma gyur gnyis su phye nas/ dang po la bya ba'i tshe sta gon gyi chos bcu bzhi dang / phyi ma la bya ba'i tshe bcu gsum gsungs nas/ bcu bzhi po yang phal cher gong du bshad pa de dang cha 'dra ba las/ cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ lus kyi bya ba dang myang 'das kyi bsam pa bskyed pa gnyis lugs 'dir gcig tu mdzad nas nang dbang bskur ba gnyis pa/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba gsum pa/ spro ba bskyed pa bzhi pa/ rgyud bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa'i don la nang gi sems bskyed la zhes gsungs nas/ dkon mchog gsum la zhes sogs mi byed par/

sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /zhes pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad 'di brjod pa'i sgo nas sems bskyed pa lnga pa/ bsrung ba bya ba drug par mdzad nas/ bsrung ba la 'dir slob dpon gyi bsnyen pa byas dus kyi srin lag gi khrag dang / bdud rtsi ril bu/ dri bzang sbyar bas gnas gsum du bsrung ba byed pa yin la/ de nas mchod pa lngas mchod pa bdun pa/ brgyad pa srung skud btags pa/ dgu pa khyor chu blud pa/ bcu pa so shing dor ba/ bcu gcig pa ku sha byin pa/ bcu gnyis pa zab mo'i chos bshad de spro ba bskyed pa/ bcu gsum pa rmi lam brtag cing / ngan na bsrung ba bya ba/ bcu bzhi pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal dang gsol btab byed pa rnams yin pas/ phyi ma 'di slob dpon gyi 'os su ma gyur pa la mi dgos pas bcu gsum du 'du ba yin zhing / so shing dang khyor chu srung skud gsum kyai rdor gyi skabs las go rim ldog nas/ srung skud sngon la bcings/ de nas khyor chu/ de nas so shing dor ba mdzad pas go rim yang cung zad mi mthun pa 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar bde kyai gnyis po dang / gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i slob ma sta gon gyi khyad par ji ltar zhe na/ 'di gsum gyi dbang gi sta gon la mi 'dra ba cher med mod/ 'on kyang gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gi slob ma sta gon gyi go rim ni/ yon dbul gsol gdab nges 'byung bskyed/ /nang dbang spro bskyed sdom pa bsrung / /gnas gsum byin rlabs de la mchod/ /so shing dri chu ku sha dang / /bsrung skud chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar don tshan bcu bzhir gsungs pa yin pa las/ dang po yon dbul ba ni/ bla ma dang dpal mi bskyod rdo rje tha mi dad pa la slob ma sta gon gyi chos 'khor bcas zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba nyid la bshad la/ de nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/

/zhes sogs kyi gsol btab byed pa don tshan gnyis par mdzad la/ 'di gnyis ni kyai rdor ltar na lus kyi bya ba zhes pa de dang gcig go /de nas don tshan gsum pa nges 'byung bskyed pa dang / bzhi pa nang dbang bskur ba/ lnga pa spro ba bskyed pa rnams ni bde kyai gnyis dang don 'dra ba yin te/ stong thun chen mo las/ bzhi pa slob ma sta gon la gnas pa la/ blo ldan theg chen la dga' ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa sgor bzhag la/ ston pa khyod la dga' 'o/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon 'khor lo'i gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas dam tshig 'di'i gnang ba byin te/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen gyi/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /la sogs brjod la spro ba bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /drug pa ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ba ste/ de yang kyai rdor gyi tshe rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas sems bskyed pa zhes pa thun mong gi sdom bzung ngam/ so thar dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnyis las mi len zhing / bde mchog gi tshe yang nang gi sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba sdom pa thun mong ba tsam zhig ka len kyang / 'dir ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum brjod pa'i sgo nas thun mong gi sdom pa bzung / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes sogs lan gsum brjod pa'i sgo nas thun mong ma yin pa bzung ba yin te/ ston thun chen mo las/ de nas skyabs 'gro dang / sdig bshags dang / yid rang ba dang / bsngo ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / lus dbul ba dang / bskul ba dang / gsol 'debs dang / sdom pa bzung ba dang / smon lam bya'o zhes dang / rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho las/

dkon mchog gsum la zhes sogs lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa gzung bar gsungs pas so/ /de nas don tshan bdun pa gnas gsum byin rlabs sam bsrung ba ni/ slob dpon gyis 'bru gsum lugs 'byung lugs ldog lan gsum brjod nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri chus reg ste bsrung ba kyai rdor dang 'dra yang / 'dir slar yang slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin yig 'bru gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas gnas gsum du thim pas/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs nas rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab pa khyad par gyi chos yin te/ stong thun chen mo las/ sdom pa bzung ba'i rjes la snying kha la sogs pa gsum du rdo rje khu tshur gyi dris thig le gsum byas te/ nyi ma dang / padma dang / zla ba la yi ge gsum so sor bkod la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab cing las thams cad sngags kyis bsrung ba bya'o/ /zhes dang / dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho las/ yi ge gsum las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis lus dri ma med par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de nas brgyad pa mchod pa dang dgu pa so shing dor ba dang / bcu pa khyor chu blud pa/ bcu gcig pa ku sha byin pa/ bcu gnyis pa srung skud byin pa/ bcu gsum pa zab mo'i chos bshad de spro ba bskyed pa/ bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba bya ba ste/ 'di dag ni bskur bya'i ngo bo la kyai rdor dang khyad par med kyang / go rim cung zad ma mthun te/ 'dir srung skud kyi sngon la ku sha ster bas so/ /'di rang gi dbang bka' gsar rnying gcig kyang go rim cung zad mi mthun te/
