gsar ma'i lugs la sngar bshad pa'i go rim de nyid yin te/ dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho las de bzhin du bshad pas so/ /dbang bka' rnying ma la ni/ so shing dor ba dang / khyor chu blud pa gnyis kyi rjes de ma thag par/ zab mo'i chos bshad de spro ba bskyed par mdzad/ de nas srung skud dang ku sha ster ba gnyis rim bzhin mdzad pa yin te/ stong thun chen mo las/ de nas las thams cad kyis bsngags kyi sngags pa'i sor shing so bcu gnyis pa 'o ma can las byas pa'i dri zhim pos byugs pa/ rtse mo me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa slob mas kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ mi smra bar bza' la mdun du drang por dor la ltas brtags te/ bdag la bltas pa'am/ rtse mo gyen du bsgrengs na dngos grub mchog shar du na 'bring mtshams dang byang du na tha ma 'jig rten pa/ thur du na sa 'og go zhes so shing dang / de nas ngag gi nyes pa sbyong ba'i phyir 'thor 'thung bya/ zhes khyor chu sbyin pa'i 'og tu gsang sngags 'byung dka' zhing / de'i sgor zhugs pa dka' ba'i chos bshad/ sems spro ba bskyed/ ces zab mo'i chos bshad de spro ba bskyed tshul gsungs nas/ de'i rjes su/ de nas las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i srung skud kyis dpung pa g.yon pa la mdud pa gsum bor te bzhag ces dpung skud 'ching tshul dang / de nas sngags btab pa'i ku sha stan dang sngas su byin la nyal du bcug la rmi ltas brtag nangs par snga bar zlos shig byas la nyal du gzhug ngan na las thams cad kyi sngags kyis gzhom/ zhes ku sha byin nas rmi lam brtag te ngan na srung ba bya tshul gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba ni/ dam tshig pa dri ba'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa/ de la mchod pa bya ba/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir gsol ba btab pa ste bzhir yod pa las/ dang po ni gang du dbang bskur ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid 'bri ba ste/

'di la yang thig gi bri ba dang / tshon gyi bri ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis sta gon gyi lha la mchod bstod dngos grub blangs pa'i bar byas la/ sngags rgyas nam mkhar btegs te slar yang mchod bstod bya/ de nas thig skud nag po dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang khu ste kha dog lnga ldan 'dus byas de dag bsang sbyang sngon du 'gro bas rim pa ltar mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rigs lngar bskyed/ nam mkhar rigs lnga'i thugs khar ye shes kyi thig skud 'od zer lnga 'phro ba bsam la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la gsol ba btab/ rang nyid mi bskyod par gsal ba'i mig gnyis su dza las nyi ma dang zla ba ser po la oṃ tiṣṭa a gu shi dza zhes pa bkod/ sngags de brjod cing mig gi rdzi ma 'bar ba'i 'gugs pa'i lta stangs kyis/ nam mkha'i rigs lnga'i thugs kha'i ye shes kyi thig skud rnams spyan drangs nas thig skud so so la bstim/ de nas oṃ a zhes sogs brjod cing / thig skud rnams dang por so sor bsgril/ de nas gcig tu bsgril la dri bzang gi chus byug cing / 'bru gsum brjod la gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag mchod pa dang byin gyis rlabs pa srung ba sogs bya/ de nas sngar las thig btab pa'i sa der/ slob dpon lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas slob ma yang rnam snang du gsal ba'i lag par thig skud kyi rtse gtad de dza dza dzaḥzhes slob dpon gyis brjod pa bzhin/ slob mas kyang brjod la tshangs thig sogs rim pas btab pa dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin lag len bya zhing / de nas gnyis pa tshon gyi cho ga ni/ tshon kha dog lnga pa 'dus byas/ rigs lngar bskyed pa la ye shes kyi tshon spyan drangs te bstim pa sogs byas nas/ slob dpon rang nyid dam slob ma ci bde bas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor phyag len bzhin 'bri ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i rdul tshon la lha so so'i mtshan ma yongs su rdzogs pa 'god pa yin te/

'di dag gi lag len rnams ni snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho dang / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i zur 'debs mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gzhan phan rgyas byed sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dam tshig pa bri ba'i tshul gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa 'di ni stong thun chen mo las/ thig gi cho ga ni rgyu ras skud gzhan du longs ma spyad pa zhes pa nas/ thig gi rnam par dbye ba ni/ dang po tshangs thig gnyis pa grwa thig gsum pa phyogs thig bzhi pa so so'i cha rnam par bsgo ba'i thig go /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa ni/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang / slob ma lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol btab skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams byas la/ rang skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang / de nas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i 'og nas zhugs/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying khar padma dang zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ bdag mdun tha mi dad du bskyed/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha rnams ye shes pa dang 'dres pa mi dgos la/ slar 'dus nas so so'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rnam snang sogs bskyed/ de nas rang gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs kha nas chos kyi phyag rgya byung ba bya rdo rje mar bskyed pa nas/ las la gnas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ lus dkyil gyi lha thig ler zhu ba padma'i dbus su babs pas/

thig le cha so gnyis su gyur pa lha so gnyis su bskyed/ mtshan sngags kyis phyir phyung / rang rang gi mdzad pa rnams mdzad pa dang / sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya zhing / de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs/ so so'i ye shes pa dang gcig tu 'dres/ mchog tu dga' ba'i sku dang ldan pas slar 'byon par bzhed bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas de dag spyan drangs pa'i phyir ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' re re/ de rnams kyi thugs kar zla gdan la so so'i phyag mtshan gyi lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' so so'i sa bon rnams bsgom/ ye shes pa rnams kyang sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsgom/ de nas rang dam tshig sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs nas lha so so la bstim/ de nas 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes zhig bdag gi mdun du 'ong bar sam/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir 'byon par skul cig ces bsgos/ des de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' khyab pa spyan drangs pa la mchod pa dang / gsol ba btab/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis spyan drangs dam tshig pa la bstim/ de nas sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar btegs pa la mchod pa dang / dgug gzhug bya/ lha so so'i rigs bdag yab yum rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar bsam pa sogs bya ba ste/ de dag ni stong thun chen mo las/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis brlab cing yo byad bsgrub pa la/ dang po dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phyag rgya 'byongs pa dang / dang po sbyor ba sngon du btang ste snyoms 'jug byas la padma nas badzra dhrika la sogs pa bton la gtso bo'i gdan bkod la bstim/

zhes pa nas/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i rdzas ni mchod pa'i rdzas te mchod pa lnga po 'bum khri/ de med na stong / gzhan yang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ cang shes kyi rta/ dpag bsam gyi shing / bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ rol mo'i cha byad bcu/ dri/ tsandan/ gla rtsi/ reg bya dar dang bal sogs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa yin la/ gsum pa de la mchod pa bya ba ni/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa/ lha so so'i sngags kyi rjes su argham̐ btags pas mchod yon dang / de nyid lngas bstod nas/ rang gi lus gzhal yas khang du bsam pa nas/ gsang mchod kyi bar dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / de nas gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags dang / yig brgya 'bru gsum rnams bzlas/ rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la gsol ba btab/ rang gtso bo'i thugs kha nas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang nas phyir 'thon/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis phyi rol gtor ma gtor chog nang bzhin byin rlabs dang 'bul ba sogs dang / yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs pa nongs pa bzod par gsol ba sogs bya ba ste/ stong thun las/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa de la mchod pa ni phyi nang gsang ba gsum ste/ zhes pa nas/ mchod pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa 'di dag gis gsal bar bstan to/ /bzhi pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ phyi rol phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs la gtor ma byin nas/ nang du slob dpon rang nyid kyis slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas la/ de nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /zhes sogs sam/ 'od gsal ba las yang dag byung / /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab cing bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ste/

ston thun chen mo las/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ de ltar gnang ba nod nas dbus kyi gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa dbus kyi pho brang la bzhugs nas/ slob ma la rang gis phar bskur tshad gcig dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor byas pas nod par bya'o/ /zhes dang / de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i don du/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i bden pa'i stobs brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen khyad par can te/ skur byed kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag rgyas par phye ba yin la/ yang skur byed kyi cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ sbyor ba la bsnyen pa/ sa chog sta gon dang gsum/ sa chog la gong du bshad pa ltar gyi don tshan rnams dang / sta gon la sa lha/ dkyil 'khor lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon te don tshan bzhi/ dngos gzhi la bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang gsum/ dang po la dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / rgyan bkram pa gnyis/ dang po la thig gi bri ba dang / tshon gyi bri ba gnyis/ bsgrub cing mchod pa la/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / de la mchod pa gnyis/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis/ phyi ma la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba gnyis te/ don tshan de dag tu phye na yang legs shing / sngar bshad pa rnams la yang don tshan de dag gi phyi ma gnyis po 'di ma gtogs thams cad tshang bar bshad pa yin no/ /bzhi pa dmigs pa'i rkyen khyad par can ni/ slob dpon gyi cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas legs par bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ 'di la dbang bka' rnying ma ba'i lugs la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / sgron gsal las/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du nyan pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la rig pa'i dbang bskur nas zhes gsungs pa ltar sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang /

rim lnga las/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mnyam bzhag pas/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i cho ga yis/ /snang ba dag ni bskyed par bya/ /zhes pa ltar tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / rgyud phyi ma las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa dang / /dkyil 'khor bha gar gsungs pa dang / /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems su gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor dang / byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dang gsum du bsdus nas dbang skur byed kyi dkyil 'khor bzhir bzhed de stong thun chen mo las/ dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ rdul tshon dang / sprul pa dang / tshogs dang / rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor brten nas las dang po pa'i gang zag gis bsgrub pa dbang bskur ba byed do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /spyir gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam grangs mang du gsungs te/ de yang mtshon par bya ba nges don don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud las/ dkyil ni snying po zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems ni bde chen po/ /len par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces snying po bde ba chen po len zhing 'dzin par byed pa la dkyil 'khor du bshad la/ snying po bde ba chen po de yang rnam snang mngon byang las/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba ste/ dkyil ni snying po zhes bya'o/ /'khor ni rdzogs pa ste/ de'i gong na snying por gyur pa gzhan med pas dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas snying po rdzogs pa la dkyil 'khor tu bshad cing / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings nyid do/ /zhes dang / nges brjod bla ma las kyang / chos kyi dbyings kyi grong khyer mchog /ces chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i pho brang la dkyil 'khor du bshad pas/ de ni nges don kyi dkyil 'khor ram mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin la/

de nyid mtshon par bya ba drang don kun rdzob pa'i dkyil 'khor la grub chen klu byang gis slob ma'i don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo rnam brgyad bri bar bya/ /rin chen de bzhin sa bon dang / /me tog tshon dang de bzhin du/ /bye ma g.yo dang phye ma dang / /de bzhin yid kyi dkyil 'khor bden/ /zhes rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la rgyu dang mtshan ma'i sgo nas dbye ba lnga dang / tshon zhes pa ras bris dang / yid kyi zhes pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang brgyad las/ dang po ni rgyu rin po che las rdul tshon byas nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / gnyis pa ni 'bras la sogs pa tshon gyis kha bsgyur nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ kye rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud las/ rdul tshon dam pa'i tshon dang ni/ /yang na 'bring po nyid kyi ste/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang don gcig la/ gsum pa ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gdan dang bcas pa bris nas lha'i mtshan ma me tog bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid yin la/ bzhi pa ni ras la tshon gyis bris pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor/ lnga pa ni bye ma tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ drug pa ni rdo la sogs pa'i phye ma tshon gyis kha bsgyur nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ bdun pa ni yid ces pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor te/ ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis lus ngag gi bya ba cung zad tsam yang med par/ sa chog nas brtsams rdul tshon gyi bya ba ji lta ba bzhin ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul nas slob ma la ston nus pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid yin zhing / 'di la ye shes zhabs lugs pa dag gis bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bshad nas 'di'i sgrub mchod la yang bsam gtan gyi sgrub mchod kyi tha snyad mdzad de/ grub chen sman pa'i zhabs kyis/

bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsam gtan gyis/ /mchod dang dbang bskur de bzhin du/ /byas nas gzhan la 'ga' yi don/ /bsgrub phyir lung 'di bsgo ba 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /brgyad pa ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor te/ grub chen dril bu pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / ma bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs pa dang don gcig cing / ye shes zhabs lugs pa 'dod pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang ni don mi gcig par bshad do/ /yang nges brjod bla ma las/ yi ge'i dkyil 'khor dang po ste/ /gnyis pa mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya gsum pa ste/ /gzugs brnyan 'god pa bzhi pa 'o/ /me tog bsam pa lnga pa ste/ /drug pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gzhan yas khang gdan bcas bris zin pa cig nyid la mtshan 'god tshul gyi sgo nas yi ge hūm̐ la sogs pa'i sa bon 'god pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / rdo rje la sogs pa phyag mtshan 'god pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / chos 'chad la sogs pa'i phyag rgya 'god pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / lha sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs bri ba'i dkyil 'khor te bzhir dbye ba dang / de dag gi steng du lha'i mtshan ma la me tog 'god pa dang / tshogs 'khor gyi dus su lha grangs dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo lha so so'i chas su zhugs nas tshogs 'khor tshul bzhin byas pa las dbang gong ma bskur bar gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid dang drug tu yang gsungs la/ yang grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas/ ri mor gnas pa'i lus dang ni/ /thig ma tshon dgye'i rim pas bstan/ /'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyi/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /zhes rdul tshon/ ras bris/ lus dkyil te gsum du yang bshad mod/ de ltar dkyil 'khor la dbye ba mang du yod kyang / grub chen klu byang gis dkyil 'khor brgyad gsungs pa'i dang po dang /

gnyis pa lnga pa drug pa dang bzhi ni rdul tshon gyi rgyu'i sgo nas so sor phye ba yin la/ gsum pa ni mtshan ma 'god tshul gyi sgo nas phye ba yin pas lnga po de dag ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'du zhing / de bzhin du nges brjod bla ma las drug tu gsungs pa'i dang po lnga yang mtshan ma 'god tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa ma gtogs/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gcig nyid kyi dbye ba yin pas/ nges brjod bla ma'i dgongs pa ltar na rgyud smin byed du rung ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang gsum du nges pa yin kyang / 'dir ni grub pa'i dbang phyug klu'i byang chub kyi dgongs pas rdul tshon dang / ras bris dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bzhir yod pa yin la/ de rnams kyi nang nas deng sang gi gang zag phal mo che smin par byed pa la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nyid gtso che bar dgongs nas rgyud sde rin po che rnams las 'di nyid dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor gsungs shing / rgyud sde'i dgongs pa de nyid grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis kyang gtso bor bzung nas/ las dang po pa'i gang zag gsar du smin pa la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nyid gtso bor phyag len du mdzad cing / de bzhin du 'gos lo chen po bsod nams rtse mos kyang stong thun chen mor sa chog nas brtsams te/ ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i bar thams cad rdul tshon kho na la sbyar te gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan thams cad kyis las dang po pa gsar du smin par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor la rdul tshon nyid mchog tu bsngags par gsungs pa yin zhing / khyad par bdag nyid chen pos sa skya paṇḍi tas/ deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod kyi/

/gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces gsungs pa'i dgongs bzhed kyi gtso bo yang de yin no/ /'o na dkyil 'khor gzhan de dag tu dbang bskur ba byas na nyes dmigs 'byung ngam zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis ni gang zag mchog la smin byed kyi dkyil 'khor du rung yang / deng sang gi gang zag phal mo che smin byed du rung ba la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor nyid gtso bor gsungs la/ 'on kyang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed mi rung ba ni ma yin te/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos/ ras bris la brten pa'i lugs 'di ni/ bde mchog a bhi dha na la brten/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa dang / dga' rab rdo rje la sogs pas gsungs la/ deng sang rgya gar na yang cho ga phal cher 'di la mdzad cing / bla ma gong ma rnams kyang skabs su phyag len 'di la mdzad pas/ lugs 'di ha cang mi legs pa yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / slob dpon dza ya se nas/ rdul tshon 'bri bar ma nus na/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /nges par bcom ldan he ru ka /phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa bri/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ras bris su smin byed rung pa la ni rtsod pa med la/ 'on kyang rdul tshon 'bri bar ma nus na/ zhes pa dang / slob dpon rin po che dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyis/ lugs 'di ha cang mi legs pa yang ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i tshig nus myangs na/ 'dir smin byed rung yang / 'di la mi legs pa'i cha cung zad yod pa zhig bstan par 'chad dgos te/ gzhan du na 'bri bar ma nus na zhes pa'i na dang / lugs 'di ha cang mi legs pa yang ma yin no zhes pa'i ha cang gnyis la dngos bstan shugs bstan gyi 'chad tshul rnal ma re dgos pa las de mi 'byung bas so/ /'o na gang yin zhe na/ lugs 'di la sa slangs brtag sbyang ba sogs cho ga rgyas pa rnams mi mdzad pas/ phyag len zor yang pa'i skyon cung zad cig byung bas/

nus na cho ga rgyas pa rdul tshon gyi phyogs 'di kho na las dang po la bya dgos shing / ci ste rgyas pa ma nus na yang ras bris 'di byas pas phyag len zor yang cung zad ma gtogs/ dbang bskur mkhan gyi rdo rje slob dpon la sngags sdom la gnod pa'i nyes pa yang mi 'byung zhing / slob ma la sngags sdom mi skye ba'i nyes pa lta bu yang med pas ha cang mi legs pa ma yin no zhes bshad na legs sam snyam du sems so/ /de rnams kyi smin byed la 'jug pa'i yan lag bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa smin byed dngos la dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbang bka' rnying ma'i lugs ltar na/ yol ba'i phyi rol tu bya ba dang / nang du bya ba gnyis kyi nang nas/ dang po la don tshan lnga dang / nang du 'jug pa la don tshan brgyad du mdzad de/ dang po phyi 'jug gi lnga ni/ stong thun chen mo las/ da ni slob ma gzhug pa la lnga ste/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mnyam par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa ni gnyis te/ dang po yol ba'i phyi rol tu bya ba'i cho ga ni lnga ste/ dang po gsol ba btab cing rgyun bshags bdun bya/ sdom pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'bog pa dang / skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa gsum slob ma sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya/ lha'i nga rgyal byed du gzhug bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bum pa'i khrus byed pa dang lnga'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa nang 'jug gi brgyad ni stong thun chen mo las/ nang du 'jug pa'i cho ga la brgyad las/ dang po sgo bzhi nas 'jug pa ni/ de ltar gdong g.yogs bcings pa ni/ ras dmar po'i gdong g.yogs kyis bkab la/ gang la dga' ba yin zhes lan gsum brjod/ des skal ba bzang la bdag dga'o byas nas/ gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i sngags kyis yol ba'i nang du bkug cing chud par bya ba'am/ yang na a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐ gis nang du chud par byas pa'o/

/lha'i dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su chud kyi/ de bas na bdag gis khyed la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ /ye shes 'dis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /zhes rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag gnas/ /oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ gal te tshul 'di smra na ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas te gshegs/ /zhes so/ /dam chu'ang blud do/ /slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrag de nas ye shes dbab/ de nas me tog bor la sku stod smad gang du babs pa la dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag de nas mgo la bcings/ de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /zhes de'ang le'u bcu drug pa las/ de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig go /a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/ zhes pa la sogs gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa lha ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gnod mdzes nas rdo rje 'chang gi bar du bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so ltar/ gdong g.yogs bcings pa/ me tog gi phreng ba gtad pa/ dri ba dri lan/ khro bo bzhi'i sngags sam a kham̐ wi ra hūm̐ gi nang du chud par byas la phan yon sogs kyi dam bzhag bzhi/ ye shes dbab pa/ lha la me tog dbul ba/ de rang gi mgo la bcing ba/ gdong g.yogs dgrol ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa rnams yin la/ lugs 'dir zla ba rdo rje ngo sprad pa dang / sngags brjod cing dkyil 'khor la bskor ba dang / phyag byed pa dang / ye shes dbab pa'i tshe mngon byang lnga las lhar bskyed pa dang / ma phebs nas spogs chog bya ba rnams ma gsungs la/ dkyil 'khor ston pa na yang lha ngo tsam las/ dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid 'dir mi ston pa yin no/

/yang dbang bka' gsar ma'i lugs ltar na/ spyir rdul tshon gyi dbang du byas te/ bum dbang yan chad kyi dbang gi chos la don tshan nyi shur mdzad de/ dkyil chog las/ dang po sa ni sbyangs pa dang / /de nas sa yongs 'dzin pa dang / /phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi dang / /thod lo skor gyi thig gdab dang / /de nas sa lha sogs lhag par/ /gnas dang de nas gsol gdab dang / /phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang / /nam mkhar thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon sna lnga yi cho ga dang / /tshon rtsi rnams ni dbye ba dang / /lha rnams spyan drangs nyid dang ni/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang / /khrus kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang / /de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang / /de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur dang / /lha dang bla ma yon gnyis dang / /rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang / /de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang / /dkyil 'khor las byed phur bu dang / /skud pa bsdu ba nyid kyang ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ dbang gi ngo bo/ dbye ba bstan pa/ thob pa'i phan yon/ ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ spyir dbang dang / sngags sdom dang / sngags kyi lam dang / sngags kyi dam tshig rnams don gcig yin pas/ de dag gi ngo bo ni smin byed kyi dus su rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du byin gyis brlab pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs nas/ grol byed kyi dus su 'bras bu'i rnam pa nyid lam du byed pa'i thabs kyi de nyid gong nas gong du 'phel bar byas te/ rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa'i thabs khyad par can zhig ste/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yis/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rang gi gzhir gnas kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi la sprul sku la sogs pa sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan du btab ste/

de'i rgyun nyams su blangs na gang zag rab tshe 'di dang / 'bring bar do/ tha ma skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du rig 'dzin gyi 'bras bu mthar thug thob par byed pa'i thabs mchog cig la bshad pa yin te/ yang sdom gsum rab dbye las/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yi/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i gnad shes na/ /de ni tshe 'di'am bar do'am/ /skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du/ /'grub par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen rin po che'i bdud rtsi spel ba las/ gang zhig thob nas sku bzhi'i sa bon rnyed/ /tshul bzhin bsrung na 'bad med sangs rgyas thob/ /brtson pas bsgrubs na tshe 'dir mchog ster ba'i/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i sdom pa bshad kyi nyon/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ rgyud sde bzhi la ma ltos pa'i dbang bzhi dang / sngags sdom bzhir yod de/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod pan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming / /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang / /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar phye/ /de bzhin drug gi bye brag dbang / /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni mtshan/ /gsang dbang yi ni dbang rgyal bshad/ /shes rab ye shes bla na med/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes bya rgyud la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang gnyis/ spyod rgyud la de gnyis kyi steng du rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang dang lnga/ rnal 'byor rgyud la de'i steng du phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang dang drug rnal 'byor bla med la de'i steng du dbang gong ma gsum ste/ rgyud sde bzhi la dbang gi babs mi 'dra ba bzhi bshad pas/ de dag gi nang nas rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang ngam/ sngags sdom la dbye na/ bcu bzhir dbye ba/ de bcu gcig tu bsdu ba/ de dag kyang bzhir bsdu ba dang gsum las/

dang po ni/ spyir bla med kyi dbang la sta gon gyi dbang dang / dngos gzhi'i dbang gnyis su yod kyang / gtso bo ni dngos gzhi'i dbang ste/ de la bum dbang la bcu gcig de'i steng du gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / dbang bzhi pa ste bcu bzhir yod de/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i ming can no/ /gsum pa kun nas sbyor ba ste/ /bzhi pa don ni dam pa 'o/ /gtso bo'i dbye ba bcu gcig ste/ /bcu gnyis pa ni gsang ba 'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni yang dag sbyor/ /bcu bzhi pa ni don dam ste/ /dbang bskur re re'i sa re 'o/ /rnam pa gsum ni rgyu yi dbang / /bzhi pa 'bras bur shes par bya/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ gsang ba spyi yi sngags dang ni/ /bdun du bcu bzhir bshad pa dang / /gnyis ka bcu bzhir 'dus pa yi/ /zhes dang / dril bu dkyil chog las/ slob dpon dbang sogs dbye ba yi/ /dbang bskur rnam pa bzhi bshad de/ /bcu bzhi la sogs dbye ba yi/ /bzhi po de yang bcu bzhi 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bcu gcig tu dbye ba ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dang po chu yi dbang bskur yin/ /gnyis pa cod pan dbang yin te/ /gsum pa dar dpyangs dbang bskur yin/ /bzhi pa rdo rje dril bu 'o/ /lnga pa rigs kyi bdag po ste/ /ming gi dbang bskur drug pa yin/ /sangs rgyas bka' bsgo bdun pa ste/ /brgyad pa bum pa'i dbang bskur yin/ /dgu pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur yin/ /shes rab ye shes bcu pa yin/ /de nyid rdo rje sbyor ba dang / /brtul zhugs thams cad byin nas su/ /bdag nyid ston pas lung bstan bya/ /cho ga de ltar khyod la bshad/ /ces dang / ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang / /dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs dang / /lung bstan pa dang skyabs sbyin dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya ye shes so/

/rnal 'byor rgyud la mos pa la/ /dbang brgyad phye la sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma la mos la/ /bcu gcig bdag nyid sbyin par bya/ /zhes bum dbang la brgyad dang / dbang gong ma gsum ste bcu gcig yang sangs rgyas mchog gi rgyud las/ chu dang cod pan dar dang ni/ /rdo rje dril bu brtul zhugs dang / /ming rgyal dbang ni rnam pa bdun/ /byis pa rnams kyis gzung phyir yin/ /gsum po 'jig rten kun rdzob dang / /bzhi pa don gyi dam pa 'o/ /bum pa gsang ba'i dbang dang ni/ /shes rab ye shes zhes bya dang / /de nas shes rab chen po yi/ /ye shes zhes bya rdzogs pa dag /'gyur dang mi 'gyur bar chad can/ /bar chad med pa de las gzhan/ /zhes byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ de'i steng du bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / dbang bzhi pa ste bcu gcig tu dbye ba'i tshul yang bshad do/ /gsum pa de dag kyang bzhir bsdu ba ni/ de ltar dbang bcu bzhi dang / bcu gcig tu dbye ba de dag kyang bsdu na bum dbang sogs bzhir 'dus te/ de dag ni bum dbang la bcu gcig dang / brgyad dang / bdun sogs phye ba'i dbang las de ltar du phye ba mdzad pa yin pas so/ /de ltar yang sdom 'byung las/ rigs kyi lhar nges me tog phreng / /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni ming gi dbang / /bde gshegs lnga yi bdag nyid dbang / /brtul zhugs dang ni lung bstan nyid/ /rjes gnang dang ni dbugs dbyung dang / /phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon dbang / /bum pa las ni byung ba 'o/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i mchog yin te/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes yin/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang yan chad la bcu gcig tu mdzad nas de dag gi bum dbang gi nang du bsdus te grangs gcig de nas gsang dbang gnyis pa dang / shes rab ye shes gsum pa/ dbang bzhi pa grangs bzhi par bshad pas so/ /des na sngar gyi bum dbang gi dbye ba de dag bum dbang gi yan lag la bum dbang gi ming gis btags nas gsungs pa yin pas/

de dag ni dngos btags ma phye bar dbye ba'am/ sgra'i brjod rigs tsam gyi dbye ba yin gyi/ grangs nges dbye ba mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin te/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi chag lo'i dri lan las/ bum dbang bcu gcig ces bya bar ming 'dogs pa ni bum dbang gi yan lag la der ming btags pa lags/ dper na rgyal po'i pho nya bcu gcig zer yang / gcig dpon dang gzhan rnams 'khor du 'gro ba dang 'dra zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na grangs nges kyi dbye ba ji lta bu zhe na/ bla med kyi dbang gi dngos bzhi la/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / dbang bzhi pa ste bzhir dbye ba 'di nyid grangs nges kyi dbye ba yin te/ dngos gzhi'i dbang la de bzhir grangs nges pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sbyang bya dri ma bzhi yin pa dang / bsgom bya lam bzhi yin pa dang / 'thob bya 'bras bu bzhi yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin te/ /dbang ni bzhi yi grangs kyi ni/ /dga' ba la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes dang / rgod pa dag pa slob dpon nyid/ /lta ba gsang ba de bzhin no/ /lag bcang la ni shes rab nyid/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa de yang nyid/ /sems can rnams kyi dngos grub phyir/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi zhes bshad/ /ces dang / 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ dbang ni rnam pa bzhi dag tu/ /rgyud 'di la ni rab tu bsgrags/ /bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba zhes byar brjod/ /shes rab ye shes gsum pa yin/ /de ni de ltar yang bzhi pa/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'bum pa las/ bskal pa sa yar byas pa yi/ /sngon du sdig pa bsags pa kun/ /de kun 'dzad pa 'gyur pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong bas so/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mchog tu rab zhugs mthong ba na/

/deng khyod sdig pa thams cad las/ /rnam grol bzang por gyur par gnas/ /zhes dang / he ru ka sngon byung las/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mthong nas ni/ /cung zad de ni mi 'grub med/ /sdig pa kun las nges par grol/ /dngos grub myur tu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i gnyis pa las/ thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi tshe na snod du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dug ni sngags kyis 'joms pa bzhin/ /sngags kyi dag byed bcud len byed/ /de bzhin slob ma dbang sogs kyi/ /ma dag pa ni dag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dang por re zhig gang tshe slob/ /lan gcig dbang rnams kyi ni bskur/ /de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi/ /nges par snod du 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes dang / dbang bskur 'di dag yang dag ldan/ /de ni dam tshig can zhes bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ rgyal ba'i sras po sa brgyad pa/ /de srid theg pa dman pas 'jigs/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /zhugs pas bdag ni grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / nag po dkyil chog las/ dbang bskur 'di dag thob nas ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /mtshams med pa dang sdig can yang / /tshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /mngon par zhugs pa tsam gyi ni/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun nas ni/ /ma bsgom pa yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sdom gsum rab dbye las/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin/ /gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pa'i/ /rten 'brel sgrig pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa dbang ma bskur ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ dam pa dang po las/

dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / /zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba med/ /ces dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na/ /sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang / /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni/ /mi zad dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ba tsam gyis stong par 'gyur/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun gyis stong pa nyid/ /dper na pi waṃ sbyor tshogs kun/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi nus/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par/ /bdag ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar/ /slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor 'di ni ma mthong bar/ /rnal 'byor pa ni dngos grub 'dod/ /mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdeg dang / /rmongs pa phub ma brdungs dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnams ni spangs pa dang / /gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas/ /bsgrub kyang ci yang mi 'grub bo/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje gur las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs par/ /dbang bskur med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gang gis rab gnas ma mthong zhing / /gang gis sbyin sreg ma byas na/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du yang / /de la dngos grub mchog nyid med/ /ces pa dang / phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar me bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /zhes dang / sdom gsum rab dbye las/ dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min/

/zhes dang / dge slong sdom pa med pa dang / /rgyal sras sems bskyed ma thob pa/ /sngags pa dbang bskur med pa gsum/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chom rkun yin/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar dbang bskur ba'i phan yon dang / ma bskur ba'i nyes dmigs rnams legs par shes par byas nas/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba rnam par dag pa zhus te/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mi nyams par bsrung ba la blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis 'bad par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis smin lam gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa grol lam la bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis su yod de/ rgyud phyi ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis der bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi ngo bo ni/ rim pa bzhin tha mal gyi rnam rtog spong ba'i spong sems dang / gya nom lhar zhen pa'i rnam rtog spong ba'i spong sems gnyis yin la/ des na bla med kyi grol byed kyi lam la bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis su grangs nges te/ spang bya tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog gnyis su nges pa dang / bsgrub par bya ba'i 'bras bu thun mong gi dngos grub dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub gnyis su nges pa dang / rang gi ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pas so/ /de ltar yang kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang pos/ spang bya 'bras bu rten dang brten pa dang / /rim gnyis grangs nges bsgrub pa'i lung rigs kyis/ /lugs mchog 'di la sdom pa'ang rim gnyis kyi/ /sdom pa gnyis su nges pa'i grangs nges 'grub/ /ces dang / rgyud phyi ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis der bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /zhes sogs dang /

thun mong mchog gi bye brag gi /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /tha mal pa ni rdo rje bzhi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i rim pa gnyis po de la yang 'phags pa klu sgrub gyis/ bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas te/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi gdang bu lta bur gsungs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bskyed rim sngon du song ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rdzogs rim nyid la rim pa lngar bzhed de/ bskyed rim ston pa la mdor byas dang mdo bsre logs su mdzad nas/ rdzogs rim ston pa la rim lnga'i gzhung mdzad pas so/ /'o na lugs 'di la lus dben bskyed rdzogs gang gi khongs su bsdu snyam na/ 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo las/ shes bya ni bskyed rdzogs ri thang mtshams par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas/ snga rabs pa dag bskyed rdzogs gang yang ma yin pa'i phung gsum pa zhig tu bzhed par snang yang / kun mkhyen rin po ches/ 'di ni mi rigs te/ 'di la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar ba'i lha'i rnam pa bsgom pa tsam las rlung gi rnal 'byor sogs med pa'i phyir na/ rang gi ngo bo bskyed rim gyi lam gyi phyogs yin la/ 'on kyang 'di ngag dben bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro yin pas/ bsdu na rdzogs rim gyi khongs su bsdu ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas na bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi nang nas ngo bo bskyed rim yin la/ bsdu ba'i tshe rdzogs rim gyi khongs su bsdu bas bskyed rdzogs ri thang mtshams pa'i phung gsum pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mi rung ba yin no/ /yang slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa/ theg pa gsar ba'i dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa/ rtags kyi dbye bas lus rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ a l̥ ka l̥'i bdag nyid ngag rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/

thams cad rnam par dag pa sems rnam par dben pa la bslab pa/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu la bslab pa/ ril por 'dzin pa dang rjes su zhig pa'i rnam pas don dam 'od gsal la bslab pa/ mthar bden gnyis zung 'jug la bslab pa dang rim pa dgur mdzad/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas bskyed rim la rim pa gcig tu mdzad nas/ lus dben dang / ngag dben/ sems dben du bsdus te rim pa lngar gsungs la/ 'o na 'phags pa yab sras rim gnyis bsgom pa'i tshul la mi mthun pa 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ 'phags pa yab sras rim gnyis kyi ngo bo la bzhed pa mi mthun pa ni med la/ rim pa dgu sogs grangs mi mthun pa ni dbye bsdu tsam gyi rnam gzhag so sor mdzad pa yin gyi/ yab sras bzhed pa 'gal ba ma yin te/ stong thun chen mo las/ yab sras thams cad kyis 'phags pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis las ma 'das pas/ yab sras nang 'gal yang med do/ /rnam gzhag gi tshul so sor byas pa tsam mo zhes gsungs pas so/ /de rnams kyis nyams su blang ba'i thabs te smin byed dbang gi rnam gzhag dang / grol byed rim gnyis kyi rnam gzhag zhib tu bstan zin pas/ lnga pa mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ 'o na lam de dag nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu ji lta bu zhig 'byung ba yin snyam na/ de la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis sam/ de gnyis la rab 'bring sogs su phye na gsum las/ dang po dngos grub bam 'bras bu tha ma ni zhi rgyas la sogs pa las bzhi'i dngos grub ni tha ma dang / rig 'dzin dang / mngon shes dang / mi snang ba dang / rgya mtsho bcag pa dang / mngags gzhug dang / sngags kyi khyad par dang / mig sman dang / las bzhi'i rab tu dbye ba la sogs pa grub pa chen po brgyad ni 'bring dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ni mchog yin te/ stong thun chen mo las/ drug pa 'bras bu ni mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis/

rab 'bring du byas na gsum/ grangs su byas na nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /zhes dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ zhi sogs bya ba'i cho ga dang / /de bzhin grub pa brgyad dang ni/ /mchog ni sangs rgyas kyang yin no/ /zhes dang / rgyud phyi ma las/ mi snang la sogs dngos grub ni/ /tha mal pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub mchog ces gsungs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar nges sam zhe na/ de ni ma nges te/ ma mtha' bla med kyi sa dang po thob pa nas/ ya mtha' sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar rnams la mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'jog ste/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter las/ cig shos rdo rje gsum yin te/ /de dang de ru rab bstan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid grub dngos grub ni/ /yang dag ye shes dbang thob bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na mchog gi dngos grub la yang gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis su 'byed dgos sam snyam ste/ dang po ni sa dang po sogs byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams dang / gnyis pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zung 'jug mi slob pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku gsum dbyer med pa nyid yin pas so/ /de la chos kyi sku ni/ sems kyi chos nyid glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba dang / de'i yul can shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad shes bya shes byed kyi spros pa dang bral ba'i tshul gyis phyin ci ma log par mkhyen pa'i ye shes me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnams so/ /chos sku de nyid sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zung 'jug dang po'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang chen por snang nas theg pa chen po'i chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang /

longs sku de nyid grub pa thob pa'i gang zag sa dang po nas dgu pa'i bar la gnas pa rnams dang / so so skye bo las dag pa rnams la gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum bcas la sogs pa sprul pa mchog dang / shākya thub pa la sogs pa sprul pa mchog ma yin par snang nas gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba bzhin du don kun bsgrub par mdzad cing / 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar de srid du mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni sprul pa'i sku yin no/ /de rnams kyis mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu bstan zin to/ /de dag gis ni 'jug bya lam gyi rim pa spyir bstan pa bshad zin to/ /spyi don gsum pa bskyed pa'i rim pa bye brag tu bshad pa la/ gang gis bsgom pa'i gang zag gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ gang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa gang yang rung ba gcig dang / de'i steng du theg chen sems bskyed dang ldan zhing / 'di'i dbang bskur ba thob la ma nyams pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du nyams su len zhing bsrung ba zhig yin te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan pas/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid min zhes gsungs/ /zhes dang / gzhan du yang / rang rang bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yi/ /yang dag cho ga rjes su gnang / /zhes dang / mdo bsrer/ las dang po'i rab tu 'jug pa'i dam tshig dang / sdom pa dang / dbang bskur ba thob pas tha mal pa'i nga rgyal dang bral ba'i thun bzhir lhag pa'i rnal 'byor la goms pas/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa gang du bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ dus 'khor las/ gang du sa skyong chos ldan zhing / /gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams/ /bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med par/ /der ni bsam gtan brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir sa phyogs de nyid chos ldan gyi rgyal pos chos dang mthun par skyong zhing /

de'i dbang gis skye dgu rnams kyang chos mthun gyi spyod pas bde bar 'tsho bas/ bsam gtan sgom pa po la gnod 'tshe sogs mi 'byung ba'i yul khams shig tu bsgom par gsungs la/ de'i nang nas kyang me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pas legs par brgyan pa'i dgon pa dang / ri bo chen po'i bya 'dabs la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su bsgom par gsungs te/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs sam/ /me tog 'bras bu sogs pas brgyan/ /ri bo dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa gang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyu yul tshul dang phan yon dang / /bslab bya rnam pa lnga yis bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya dang lnga las/ dang po la yang 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyi/ dang po 'jigs pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ sngon chad khyed kyis bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag gzhan srid pa'i sdug bsngal nyam thag pa ches che ba rnams kyis nyen pa la cher 'jigs pas/ sdug bsngal de las yongs su skyobs pa'i blos skyabs su 'gro ba yin la/ gnyis pa dad pa ni/ sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa de las skyobs pa'i nus pa su la yod na/ bla ma dkon mchog la yod pas de dag gi yon tan la sems dang ba dang / de dag gi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo la yid ches pa ste dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa gsum kyi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/

/gsum pa snying rje ni/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ lus bcad ster zhing bdag gi sdug bsngal gyi/ /gzhan dag rnams kyi dmyal ba la sogs pa/ /sdug bsngal rang rig nyid du mthong nas ni/ /de bcad bya phyir myur du brtson 'grus rtsoms/ /zhes pa ltar theg chen gyi rigs sad pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig rang gi sdug bsngal la rjes su dpags nas rang gzhan sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa la mi bzod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ de dag yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba yin no/ /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du dar sna tshogs kyi gdan dang / padma/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa ste gdan drug brtsegs kyi steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid ngo bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang / rnam pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa dang bcas pa la gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i rgyab tu chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu rnams gsal btab/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan ni/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba drin can gyi pha mar gyur pa rnams dang rang nyid do/ /dus ni snying po byang chub kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba yin no/ /gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ skyabs yul de dag mngon sum ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rang nyid bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug ste/ rang gi rtsa ba'i pha ma gnyis kyis thog drangs mkha' khyab rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyang rang gi nye 'khor du 'khod nas lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i sgo nas bla ma dang sangs rgyas la rnam grol gyi lam ston pas ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/

dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa rang gis skyabs 'gro byed pa ltar/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyis kyang byed par mos la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi sgrub thabs las/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par byas la zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ces sogs skyabs 'gro bzhi skor nyer gcig la sogs pa byas la/ mjug tu bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod pa'i rkyen gyis skyabs yul rnams rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma dkon mchog gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsam pa yin no/ /bzhi pa phan yon ni/ 'o na tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro byas pa la phan yon ji ltar yod ce na/ skyabs 'gro 'di ni sdom pa thams cad skye ba'i rgyu yin pa sogs 'bras bu mtha' yas pa zhig dang ldan par bshad de/ mdo las/ skyabs song bsod nams 'di la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha' bar snang 'di yang snod du chung / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /lnga pa bslab bya ni/ spyi'i bslab bya skyes bu dam pa dang 'grogs pa sogs dang / so so'i bslab bya sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la phyag mi bya/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod 'tshe spongs/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs pa rnams la bslab par bya ba yin no/ /de ltar bshad pa'i skyabs yul rnams kyi bla ma dang gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo tha mi dad pa ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos po ti ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog yin la/ yang bla ma gcig nyid la yang dkon mchog gsum po tshang ba yin te/ bla ma'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung chos/ thugs sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin pas so/

/de ltar yang bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ dri med sku ni sangs rgyas te/ /gsung ni chos su shes par bya/ /sku ni dge 'dun nyid yin te/ /zhes dang / bdag nyin chen po sa paṇa gyis/ dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i/ /bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter/ /dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na gsang sngags zab mo'i nyams len byed pa'i tshe/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha dang / dkon mchog gsum dang / chos skyong srung ma nor lha sogs tha dad med par shes pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa sogs bya dgos te/ lha dang bla ma tha dad par bzung ba las/ 'bras bu mi 'byung bar bshad pas so/ /bla ma de yang rang nyid la bla med kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu sku bzhi'i sa bon 'debs mkhan zhig dgos te/ spyir bla ma la rang nyid la dbang ma bskur bar rgyud/ man ngag cung zad bstan pa sogs dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel pa tsam yod pa'i bla ma dang / dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur te tshe 'di dang bar do sogs su 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang stsol ba'i bla ma gnyis las/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i bla ma dang / gsang sngags kyi bla ma yin kyang slob ma rang nyid la dbang ma bskur ba'i bla ma rnams ni/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum sogs la phar bsdus nas bsgom par bya dgos te/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ gal te dbang bskur ma thob na/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum nyid du/ /phar la bsdus la gsol ba thob/ /rim gyis byin rlabs ci rigs 'jug /ces gsungs pas so/ /'o na dbang ma bskur ba'i bla ma de dkon mchog gsum du phar bsdus nas gsol ba btab na/ tshe 'di sogs su sangs rgyas sbyin nus sam snyam na/ de las ni rim gyis sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba tsam srid kyi/

sangs rgyas dngos su sbyin nus pa ni ma yin te/ ji skad du/ gsang sngags min pa'i bla ma la/ /mos pa byas kyang tshe 'di yi/ /bde skyid phun tshogs tsam zhig gam/ /rim gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur srid kyi/ /tshe 'di'am bar do la sogs su/ /sangs rgyas nyid sbyin mi nus so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na rang nyid kyi bla med kyi dbang bskur ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i bla ma de nyid la skyabs dkon mchog gsum sogs tshur bsdus nas gsol ba btab na/ dkon mchog gsum po thams cad kyi/ byin rlabs bla ma gcig nyid las 'byung ba yin te/ ji skad du/ des na dbang bskur thob pa'i mis/ /dkon mchog gsum po bla ma ru/ /'dus par mthong nas bla ma la/ /gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'jug /ces gsungs pas so/ /de bzhin du bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par gsungs pa yang / dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur mkhan gyi bla ma nyid la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin te/ bla ma sangs rgyas nyid yin zhes/ /bya ba dbang bskur thob nas yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyu mtshan des na gsang sngags bla med kyi skabs su spangs rtogs mthar thug pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lta bu zhig dang / rang nyid la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur mkhan gyi bla ma so so skye bo gnyis/ yul rang gi ngos nas snga ma khyad par du 'phags kyang / rang nyid la phyi ma nyid gtso bor gsungs te/ snga mas dbang ma bskur bas yul rang gi rtogs pa mtho yang / nyid kyi rtogs pa de nyid gzhan la spo bar mi nus shing / sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs ni dbang bzhi ma bskur ba nas dngos su sbyin pa mi nus la/ phyi mas ni rang rgyud la rtogs pa chen po med kyang / slob ma la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i sgo nas sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan du btab pas na tshe 'di dang bar do sogs su sangs rgyas sbyin nus pa yin par bshad pa'i phyir na/ rang la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur mkhan gyi bla ma de nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che ba yin te/

dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba'i bla ma de med na/ slob ma dad pa dang 'dun pa mchog tu che zhing / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la nye ring med kyang / slob ma rang rgyud la mchog gi dngos grub bskyed par mi nus pas so/ /des na slob ma dad 'dun chen po zhig gis bla ma dbang bzhi mtshan nyid pa bskur ba po zhig la yang blo sems rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab na mchog gi dngos grub nyid bde blag tu stsol nus pa yin te/ dper na nam mkha' dwangs pa la nyi ma'i 'od zer sgrib byed kyi skyon gang yang med cing / nyi ma de nyid kun la mnyam par 'char ba dang / de las me 'dod pa'i skyes bus rtsol ba'i spra ba sogs rlan dang bral ba 'grub na yang / me shel med na skyes bu de la nyi ma dang spra ba la brten pa'i me mi 'byung zhing / skyes bu brtson 'grus dang ldan pa zhig la/ spra ba rlan dang bral ba dang / nyi ma sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba rnams 'dzoms pa'i steng du/ me shel gas chag med pa zhig yod na/ me shel de la nyi ma'i 'od zer bsdus pa na/ spra ba las me 'byung ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa bzhin te/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang / /me shel med par me mi 'byung / /de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang / /bla ma med par 'byung mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de nyid yin pas so/ /des na de lta bu'i bla ma gcig la dkon mchog gsum tshang bas skyabs yul bla ma nyid gsal btab kyang 'gal ba med pa yin no/ /'dis ni phyi rol mu stegs byed las khyad par du 'phags pa grub ste mu stegs pa dag ni dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mi 'gro bas na/ lam log pa'am phyi rol pa zhes bya la/ de las khyad par du bya ba'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba'i lam 'di gsungs pa yin pas so/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/

sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes gsungs pa ste/ de yang de ltar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas/ lam log pa las khyad par 'phags par grub kyang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bas de dag las khyad par mi che'o snyam na/ de las khyad par du bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bya dgos te/ de ltar byas na 'og nas bsgom par 'gyur ba'i lam thams cad gzhan don du 'gyur ba dang / bsam pa des zin na nyams len thams cad theg pa chen po'i nyams len du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod pas so/ /de ltar yang spyod bsdus las/ thog mar sangs rgyas pa'i bsam pas bskyed pa la bslab par bya/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /des na sems bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med la/ pha ma byas res kyis phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ drin can 'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba snying re rje snyam du yang nas yang du bsgom par bya dgos te/ snying rje 'di sngon du ma song na sems bskyed rnal ma mi skye bas de sngon du btang nas/ 'bras bu sems bskyed pa dngos ni/ sems can thams cad kyis thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i don nam ched du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ste/ de nyid kyi sa bdag gis thob par bya zhes thog mar smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ go 'phang de thob par bya ba'i ched du lam gang nyams su len na/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa lha sum cu so gnyis bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang /

snying po sngags kyi bzlas pa dang bcas pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed pa'i don yid la dran bzhin pas gong gi sgrub thabs kyi sems bskyed pa'i tshig lan gsum brjod/ 'dis ni lam dman pa las khyad par du 'phags pa grub bo/ /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ ces pa'i bar te/ de dag gi don yang 'di la lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs padma dang / de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed sogs med par skad cig gis rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid thabs byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i dus kyi zla ba nya gang ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar ches cher dkar zhing dwangs pa chos kyi dbyings mi 'gyur ba mtshon pas zhal gcig pa/ bden gnyis zung 'jug mtshon pas phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rdo rje dang / g.yon pas stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa des thabs shes gnyis med mtshon pa'i phyir yum la 'khyud pa/ spyi bor ral pa'i thor cog can thugs zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sku la mgul rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan cing / zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de lta bu'i pang na shes rab stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo yum rdo rje snyems ma yang sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan kha dog dang dbyibs sna tshogs pa can gyis legs par brgyan pa zhig bsgom mo/

/de ltar lha bsgom tshul 'di la bde mchog a bhi dha nar/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka yum rdo rje snyems ma gri thod 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bskyed par bshad kyang / 'dir grub chen klu byang gi dkyil chog gi dril bu'i dbang gi skabs su/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gnyis bshad pa ltar/ nag po dam tshig gi rdo rje'i rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog tu yang sngar bshad pa'i lha bsgom tshul de nyid 'byung ba ltar/ deng sang phyag len la yang mdzad pa'i pha rgyud pa'i lugs de yin no/ /gnyis pa sngags bzla ba la/ ji ltar bzla ba'i dmigs pa/ bzla bya'i sngags/ ji tsam bzla ba'i grangs dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ de lta bu'i yab kyi thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thugs ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ kha dog dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po/ ngo bo ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pa la rnam pa bdud rtsi dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs nas yab kyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ dkar po de la thim par bsgoms nas/ bcom ldan 'das zhes bos te bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang / nyes ltung la sogs pa dri ma'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes yid la bsam zhing gsol ba btab pas/ de'i rkyen gyis yab kyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs pas/ thog mar yab nyid kyi sku'i nang gang nas bdud rtsi de nyid yab kyi sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi padmar babs te yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis kyi sku'i cha shas thams cad gang ste/ sbyor mtshams las bdud rtsi dkar po dpag tu med pa skya chi li li babs/

bdag gi spyi gtsug nas mar zhugs pas nyi ma shar bas mun pa rang sangs la 'gro ba bzhin/ bdag gi rgyud la yod pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pa rang gi gshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas nag nyi li li thon nas cung zad kyang med par byas/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos mer gyis gang bar gyur par bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba yin no/ /gnyis pa bzla bya'i sngags ni/ a bhi dha nar/ dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /'di ni kun gyi gsang sngags te/ /zhes lha thams cad kyi gsang sngags yi ge brgya pa yin la/ de la yang mang du yod pa'i nang nas 'di ni grub chen klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa nyid bzla bar gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma gong ma dag gis de bzhin du mdzad pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i sngags don yang oṃ ni bkra shis pa la sogs pa don brgyad la 'jug kyang / 'dir ni mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i don te/ badzra satwa ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ sa ma ya ni dam tshig ma nu pā la ya ni rjes su skyongs shig ces pa ste/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi stong pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' bdag skyongs shig ces pa'i don yin la/ tshul ji ltar skyong na/ badzra satwa twe no pa tiṣṭha ste rdo rje sems dpa' nye bar mnos pa ste/ rang gi bsam pa bzhin du'o/ /dhri ḍo me bha wa ni bdag la brten pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su to ṣyo me bha wa ni bdag la dga' ba'i rang bzhin du'o/ /a nu rakto me bha wa ni bdag la rjes su chags pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su po ṣyo me bha wa ni bdag la mdzes pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha ni bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol ces pa ste/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bdag la rjes su skyongs shig ces pa'i don yin no/ /bskyangs nas ci byed ce na/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru ste bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/

gang gnas par mdzod na/ hūm̐ ste chos kyi dbyings mi 'gyur ba'i gnas dang / ha ha ha ha ste bzhi po de ni ye shes gzhan bzhi/ ho ni dbyer med pa ste/ mdor na dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i nges don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' de bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod cig pa'i don no/ /de nyid la ming ji skad bya na bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya zhing / des bdag nam yang spang bar bya ba ma yin pas/ ma mme muñtsa ste ma gtong zhig go /badzri bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥste rdo rje rang bzhin dam tshig sems dpa' zhes bos nas/ khyod kyis bdag dus nam yang ma gtong zhig ces pa'i don yin la/ ā ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad kyi sgo yin pas lha dang / sngags dang / sgrub pa po rnams rang bzhin skye med du gcig pa'i don to/ /gsum pa grangs ji tsam bzla ba ni/ grangs brgya stong sogs mang bar bzlas na bzang zhing / nyung tha yang nyer gcig yin te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzla/ /ltung sogs byin gyis brlab 'gyur bas/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya/ /'bum phrag dag ni bzlas gyur na/ /rnam par thag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'di bzlas pa'i dgos pa ltung ba byin gyis brlab pa ste stobs nyams par byed pa dang / mi 'phel ba'i ched yin la/ dgos pa de dag bsgrub pa la nyer gcig las nyung ba ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa bshags sdom bya ba ni/ de ltar yi ge brgya pa grangs ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba de nyid la bdag nyid lus kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhing / ngag gi sgo nas bla ma'i bstod pa brjod de/

yid gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud do/ /de yang lan gcig ma yin pa slar yang phyag 'tshal zhing yang yang du 'dud cing / de ltar du phyag 'tshal zhing bstod par bgyi'o/ /gus pa chen pos bla ma'i sku la bdag gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gi bsgrubs pa bzhin grub par gyis shig ste mdzod cig par gsol 'debs sngon du btang nas/ sambu ṭa las/ bud med dang ni skyes pa'i lus/ /las ni du mas bskyed pas na/ /mi shes pas kyang mi bya ste/ /sku yi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /zhes pa ltar gyi sku yi dam tshig dang / phrag dog nyid kyis ma rangs pas/ /tshig rtsub la sogs smra mi bya/ /rna ba bde bar byed pa nyid/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi gsung gi dam tshig dang / sems can sna tshogs gdung ba rnams/ /kun rtog dra ba'i rnam rtog gis/ /sems la smad par mi bya ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi thugs kyi dam tshig gsum mam/ yang na rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gnyis su dam tshig thams cad 'dus pas de dag mi shes pa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / snyoms las kyi dbang du gyur nas nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa ste nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / sgrib pa ste shes sgrib dang / rang bzhin gyi nyes pa dang bcas pa'i ltung ba rnams dang / gnas kyi grib ma la sogs pa grib drug gi tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag nas med par mdzad du gsol zhes slar yang gsol pas/ bla ma de nyid rang la thim par bsgom par bya ste/ rje btsun rin po ches/ thun 'jog khar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum bdag rang la thim pas lus 'ja' tshon ltar gyur par bsgom zhes gsungs pas so/ /ma rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang la thim nas rang gi lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur par bsgom dgos par bshad cing / 'don cha la yang de bzhin mdzad pa yin yang /

'dir ni de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ thun 'jog khar rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' gong du gsal btab pa'i yab yum de gnyis bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rnam pa 'od phung gi tshul du 'od du zhu nas/ spyi bo nas rang gi lus la thim pas rang gi lus gsal zhing dwangs pa 'ja' tshon gyi lus lta bur gyur par bsgom pa yin no/ /'o na sgrub thabs mdor byas las rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas sogs dngos su ma gsungs pas mi 'thad do snyam na/ skyon med de/ der dngos su ma gsungs pa ni/ 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs la dang por rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog gi sgo nas lo dang zla ba sogs su tshogs bsags te rgyud sbyangs/ de'i rjes su sgrub thabs bsgom pa la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas so/ /de lta bu'i phyag len 'phags pa yab sras sogs gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa nag po dam tshig rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog 'di yin par bshad de/ de nyid las/ mdor bsdus rim las gsung don rtogs dka' ba/ /byis pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba'i phyir/ /rdor sems mchod chog gzhan gyis byas pa bzhin/ /bla ma'i lung las cho ga bzhin bshad bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na dang por rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog gi sgo nas bsags sbyangs legs par byas pa'i rjes su bskyed rim la slob na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ma byas kyang rung la/ sngon du ma byas pa'am byas pa yin yang dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas nges par bya dgos par gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro gsum po byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ skyabs 'gro byas pas so sor thar pa'i nyes pa phra mo thams cad sor tshud/ sems bskyed byas pas byang sems kyi nyes pa phra mo thams cad sor chud/

rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas byas pas rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'i nyes pa phra mo rnam dag byas/ mdor na sdom pa gsum la ltos pa'i nyes ltung phra mo rnams sngon 'gro de gsum gyis dag ste/ lam nyams su blangs pas dngos grub myur du thob pa'i rgyu byed pa yin te/ 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho ga rab tu brtan/ /de ltar sngags pa tshul ldan pa/ /dngos grub la ni thogs pa med/ /ston pa sangs rgyas sogs bstod cing / /lha sogs 'jig rten kun gyis bkur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang gsum las dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la/ yul dag pa la brten nas bsags pa dang / yul ma dag pa brten nas bsags pa gnyis las/ dang po la yang tshogs zhing spyan drang ba/ de la phyag mchod dang rgyun bshags sogs bya ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni sgrub thabs las/ rang skad cig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus par gsal ba'i snying khar padma dang / nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ 'og min nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la 'od zer rang gi snying khar bsdu'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang rgyas par na kyai rdor dang bde mchog gi skabs su sgrub pa po las dang po pa'i gang zag gis dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mi bsgom par/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i nga rgyal gyis tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs te mchod bstod/ sdig pa bshags pa/ sdom pa bzung ba sogs byed pa la/ kyai rdor ba ltar na maṇḍal sgrub mchod dang / bde mchog pa ltar na phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga'am/ phyi rol tshogs bsags zhes bya ba byed pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang lha sum cu so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing /

rnal 'byor gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin rdzogs par bsgom mi shes pa'am mi nus pa'i gang zag des mdun du ba chu dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i sa gzhi la me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du lha sum cu so gnyis kyi phan yon bsgom ste/ de lha so gnyis kyi ngo bor mos la/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod bstod/ sdig bshags/ sdom pa bzung ba/ bzlas pa la sogs pa zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gcig gam/ lo phyed dam/ lo gcig la sogs pa'i bar du rdo rje sems dpa' dgyes pa'i mtshan ma nam byung gi bar du byas nas/ de nas mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa la 'jug pa yin la/ de'i dbang du mdzad nas 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mdor byas las/ 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung legs gnas te/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /gnas bsrung ba ni brtsam par bya/ /zhes pa las tshogs gnyis bsags pa dngos su ma gsungs pa yin la/ de la brten nas rje 'gos dang / de'i rjes 'brangs rdog pa sogs kyi sgrub thabs rnams las/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa ma mdzad la/ bla ma gser lding pa gzhon nu 'od kyis dus kyi 'khor lo'i rigs pa bkab ste srung 'khor gyi rjes la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags byas te/ de nas/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /ces sogs kyi ye shes kyi tshogs bsags byed par bshad pa ni klu byang gi rnam gzhag rim par bshad pa'i sbyang gzhi dang mi 'grig pas mi 'thad par bshad pa yin no/ /des na mdor byas las dngos su ma bshad kyang / mdo bsre las/ de ltar mdo dang bsre ba rgyas par bshad nas da ni mdor bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ de la thog mar gnas kyi nges pa dang / snying rje chen po la dmigs pa dang / zhes pa nas/ las kyi rab tu dbye ba rnams kyang shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mdor byas kyi don bsdus par bshad pa'i snying rje chen po la dmigs pa zhes pas/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags tshul bstan cing /

de'i sngon du yul dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags byed pa rnal 'byor bla med spyi'i lugs yin pas/ mngon rtogs kyi sngon 'gro la tshogs gnyis bsags pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa re dgos pa yin te/ slob dpon a bha dha nas rim lnga zla 'od du/ zhe sdang rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ 'dir sgrub pa pos dang por snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i sa bon hūm̐ gi 'od zer dag gis 'og min nas dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la mdun gyi nam mkha' la blta ste/ sa bon las byung ba'i me tog la sogs pa dang / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa nas stong pa nyid kyi bar du bsgom la/ zhes sogs bshad pas so/ /des na da lta rgyun gyi nyams len dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs kyi tshe mdzad pa 'di ni tshogs bsags bsdus pa yin pas/ de'i don yang thog mar tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa la/ gang gis 'dren pa yin snyam na/ 'di la ting nge 'dzin dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang gsum la/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rang nyid skad cig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gsal ba'i snying khar padma dang / de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ste/ de'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum mtshon par nus pa'i yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam pa zhig bsam ste/ des spro gzhi byas pa las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can kha dog lnga ldan dpag tu med pa 'phros pa de rnams kyis spyan 'dren pa yin la/ gnyis pa sngags ni/ badzra sa ma dzaḥste rdo rje dam tshig byon zhes pa'i don can gyi sngags nyid yin zhing / gsum pa phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya ste/ de yang de nyid 'dus pa dang / gdong drug gi rgyud las bshad pa ltar/ lag gnyis padma'i bskor ba sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud rgya dang / dpung pa'i steng du se gol gyi sgras de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa las bslangs nas/

de nyid mdzub mo lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas g.yab pa de nyid yin pas/ de'i sgo nas spyan drangs pa'o/ /'o na gnas gang nas spyan 'dren zhe na/ 'di la rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren pa dang / 'og min nas spyan 'dren pa gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po ni chos sku'i ngang du bzhugs pa de 'od zer des rkyen byas nas gzugs skur bzhengs pa'am/ yang na mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs kyang rang gi sgrib pas ma mthong pa de nyid 'od zer des sgrib pa bsal nas mthong bar mos pa la bya ba yin la/ phyi ma ni 'og min stug po bkod pa zhes bya ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhugs gnas de nyid nas spyan 'dren pa yin pa las/ 'dir ni phyi ma ltar ro/ /yul ji lta bu zhig spyan 'dren pa yin snyam na/ sgrub pa po rang gi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i bla ma dang gnyis su dbyer med pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rnams so/ /gang du spyan 'dren na/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan 'dren/ tshul ji lta bus spyan 'dren na/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de nyid las/ gsang ba 'dus pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa sprul pa mchog de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis spyan drangs pas byon par bsam dgos pa yin no/ /'o na gong gi rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ des sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ji ltar mtshon snyam na/ hūm̐ 'di la ha u ma gsum yod pas/ ha ni sku rdo rje'i sa bon/ u'i a ni gsung rdo rje'i sa bon/ ma ni thugs rdo rje'i sa bon te/ mngon zhes pa yid yin la/ yid la thugs ni don gcig pa'i dbang du byas par bshad do/ /de lta bu'i hūm̐ de'i 'od zer dang / rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pa rnams kyis spyan drangs la/

slar 'od zer de dag thams cad rang gi snying khar bsdu bar bya ste/ de yang man ngag snye ma sogs las bshad pa yin no/ /tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa'i ting nge 'dzin hūm̐ de yang / bha bya kirti'i 'grel chung dang / spro lung pa kun smon dang / cha ru ba rnams kyi 'di'i sgrub thabs las/ zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dkar por bshad/ de yang nyer bsdu'i skabs su rang rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar por zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsgoms nas/ thun mtshams thams cad du de'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa la dgongs pa yin pas de ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon por byed pa 'di ni/ bde kyai sogs su thun mtshams su yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bshad pa ltar/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal 'dzin dgos pas na de la dgongs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de la phyag mchod dang rgyun bshags sogs bya ba la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa 'bul ba/ rgyun bshags bya ba/ sdom pa bzung ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ de nas/ khams gsum spyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam 'gyur dngos kun ngo bo nyid/ /ces pa nas/ zhes pas phyag 'tshal bya/ zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang phyag 'tshal pa'i tshig la spro lung pa/ la ru ba sogs kyis na mo gu ru bhyaḥ zhes pas/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba dang / na maḥshrī gu hya sa mā dzaḥ maṇḍal bhyaḥzhes sngags tsam gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag 'tshal bar bshad/ kha cig gis gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs kyis phyag bya ba dang / yang dge ldan pas rgyud phyi mar bshad pa'i/ 'ga' zhig gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang / /zhes sogs bstod pa'i tshig mang pos phyag 'tshal bar 'dod cing de bzhin byed mod kyang / snga ma ni bla med kyi sgrub thabs gzhan phal cher las kyang de dang tshul mtshungs pa zhig 'byung bas gtan nas mi rung ba ni ma yin la/

bar pa ni pha rgyud kyi skabs 'dir cung zad mi bde ste/ de ni ma rgyud pa'i sgos chos yin pas so/ /phyi ma yang ye nas mi rung ba rang yang min mod kyang / skabs thob dang bstun nas mang nyung 'tshams pa zhig dgos pa las/ dge ldan pa'i 'di la tshig mang pa'i skyon yod pas 'di ni mi rigs par gsungs pa yin la/ des na 'dir mdor byas kyi mchod bstod khams gsum spyod pa las grol zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyis phyag bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma gong ma sgrub thabs mdzad pa phal cher gyis kyang mdzad cing / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rim lnga'i gzhung las/ rim lnga re re'i thog mar rim pa so so dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod re mdzad pa ltar/ 'dir yang bskyed rim dang mthun pa'i phyag 'tshal ba yin pas na lugs 'di legs pa yin no/ /des na tshigs bcad 'di'i don ni gong du bstan pa ltar tshogs zhing spyan drangs te/ de nas tshogs kyi zhing de dag la tshogs bsogs tshul ji lta bu snyam na/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba'i don ni 'dod khams/ gzugs khams/ gzugs med khams te khams gsum gyi spyod pa ni skye rga na 'chi gsum la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal la spyod pa ste/ de dag las grol ba ste rtsad nas spangs shing / nam mkha' dngos po thams cad la khyab kyang dngos po'i ngo bor mi gnas pa ltar/ yum la sogs pa lha thams cad la khyab pa'i bdag nyid yin yang / de rnams kyi ngo bor mi gnas pas na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'am mtshungs par gyur pa ste phung po la sogs pa dngos po kun dang ngo bo nyid dbyer med pas/ las kyi sgrib pa dang bral ba dang / 'dod chags dang khong khro ba la sogs pa nyon mongs pa mngon 'gyur ba dang bral bas zhi ba dang / de dag gi bag la nyal dang bral bas dag cing / ches phra ba gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bral bas na rnam par dben pa/ gzhan yang gnyid dang / rmugs pa dang / 'du byed pa dang / 'du mi byed pa la sogs pa nyan thos rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dang bral bas na mchog tu zhi ba ste/

chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa'i ye shes nyid kyi yul yin gyi/ gzhan nyan thos la sogs pa'i blo'i yul ma yin pas na go dka' ba'am rtogs par dka' ba/ rtog ge'i blo'i yul ma yin pas na brtag par dka' ba/ bdag dang gzhan tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas tshe 'di bde ba la bkod pas phan pa dang / rang gzhan tshe phyi ma'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas tshe phyi ma'i bde ba la bkod pas na rab tu phan par mdzad pa/ de yang bdag gzhan mnyam pas na khyab cing / sngon po la sogs pa kha dog 'di'o zhes gzung du med pas mtshan ma med pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bdud las rgyal ba'i sku/ gdul bya'i snang ngor mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba lha dang mi la sogs pa'i bde ba dang mnyam pa ste/ de dag las yun ring ba dang / zag pa med pa dang / rgya che bas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku/ gang du yang ma gtogs pa'i don dam pa'i bden pa dang / tha snyad du tshul 'di dang 'di'o zhes so sor 'byed pa kun rdzob kyi bden pa gnyis gcig tu rtogs pa dang ldan pa rdo rje 'chang dang rnam dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ sgrub thabs las/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ shrī gu hya sa mā dzaḥzhes pa nas/ rdo rje ma lnga'i phyag rgya mchod phreng bzhin bya/ zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang gong du spyan drangs pa'i tshogs zhing rnams la dmigs nas sgrub thabs kyi bsam bya las/ thugs ka nas rang rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i sgo nas thog mar mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / rdo rje ma lngas mchod pa rnams sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'bul ba ste/ sngags don ni/ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa/

sarba ni thams cad/ ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa/ shrī ni dpal/ gu hya ni gsang ba/ sa mā dzaḥni 'dus pa/ maṇḍa la ni dkyil 'khor/ sa pa ri wā ra ni 'khor dang bcas pa/ argham̐ ni mchod yon/ pra titstsha ni so sor/ pu dza mchod pa/ me ga ni sprin/ sa mu dra ni rgya mtsho/ spha ra ṇa 'phro ba/ sa ma ya ni dam tshig shrī ni dpal te/ de ltar na mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho so sor 'phro ba'i dam tshig gi dpal zhes par 'gyur bas kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi tshul bstan pa yin la/ de bzhin du puṣpe me tog dhuṣpe bdug spos/ a lo ke zhes pas mar me/ gandhes dri chab dang / nai wi dyas zhal zas dang / shaptas rol mo rnams phul rjes/ oṃ āḥru pa badzra hūm̐ zhes gzugs rdo rje ma dang / de bzhin du ru pa zhes pa'i gnas su shapta zhes pa bcug pas sgra rdo rje ma dang / gandhes dri rdo rje ma/ ra sas ro rdo rje/ parṣe zhes pas reg bya rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod cing / so so'i phyag rgya ni mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar yin gyi/ mchod yon ni chos 'byung gi phyag rgyas 'bul bar rdo rje gdan bzhi las 'byung ba ltar/ mnga' bdag mai tri pas kyang mdzad pa yin la/ rdo rje ma lnga'i phyag rgya ni/ 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba'i phyag rgya gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang bya ba yin no/ /'di la bu ston rin po che'i sgrub thabs las chu 'bul ba ma gsungs la/ dge ldan pa sogs chu bzhi 'bul ba mdzad cing / de yang phreng ba nas bshad pa la thugs rtse gtad kyang / 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung gang du yang chu bzhi 'bul ba ma bshad cing / a bhya ka ras kyang rnam pa kun tu chu bzhi 'bul ba ma bshad par/ rgyas pa'i tshe chu bzhi/ 'bring gi tshe chu gsum/ bsdus pa'i tshe chu gcig 'bul ba lta bu'i phyag len ches 'tshams pa zhig gsungs te/ phreng bar/ zhabs bsil dang / bsang gtor dang / zhal bsil dang / mchod yon sbyin pa'i rim pa 'di ni phal che ba las mthong ngo /
